text.KJV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
text.ASV: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:
text.WEB: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

text.KJV: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
text.ASV: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.
text.WEB: but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

text.KJV: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
text.ASV: And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also doth not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
text.WEB: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

text.KJV: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
text.ASV: The wicked are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
text.WEB: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

text.KJV: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
text.ASV: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
text.WEB: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

text.KJV: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
text.ASV: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous; But the way of the wicked shall perish.
text.WEB: For Yahweh knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

text.KJV: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
text.ASV: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?
text.WEB: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

text.KJV: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,
text.ASV: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, `saying',
text.WEB: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

text.KJV: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
text.ASV: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.
text.WEB: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

text.KJV: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD shall have them in derision.
text.ASV: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.
text.WEB: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

text.KJV: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
text.ASV: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:
text.WEB: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

text.KJV: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
text.ASV: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.
text.WEB: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

text.KJV: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
text.ASV: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.
text.WEB: I will tell of the decree. Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

text.KJV: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
text.ASV: Ask of me, and I will give `thee' the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
text.WEB: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

text.KJV: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
text.ASV: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
text.WEB: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

text.KJV: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
text.ASV: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
text.WEB: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

text.KJV: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
text.ASV: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.
text.WEB: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

text.KJV: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
text.ASV: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him. Psalm 3 A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
text.WEB: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

text.KJV: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
text.ASV: Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.
text.WEB: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

text.KJV: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
text.ASV: Many there are that say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah
text.WEB: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

text.KJV: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
text.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory and the lifter up of my head.
text.WEB: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

text.KJV: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
text.ASV: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. Selah
text.WEB: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

text.KJV: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
text.ASV: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.
text.WEB: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened; for Yahweh sustains me.

text.KJV: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
text.ASV: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.
text.WEB: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

text.KJV: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
text.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
text.WEB: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

text.KJV: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
text.ASV: Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah: Thy blessing be upon thy people. Selah Psalm 4 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Salvation belongs to Yahweh. Your blessing be on your people. Selah.

text.KJV: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
text.ASV: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large `when I was' in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
text.WEB: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

text.KJV: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
text.ASV: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? `How long' will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah
text.WEB: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah.

text.KJV: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
text.ASV: But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.
text.WEB: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly: Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

text.KJV: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
text.ASV: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah
text.WEB: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

text.KJV: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
text.ASV: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in Jehovah.
text.WEB: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

text.KJV: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
text.ASV: Many there are that say, Who will show us `any' good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
text.WEB: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

text.KJV: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
text.ASV: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than `they have' when their grain and their new wine are increased.
text.WEB: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

text.KJV: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
text.ASV: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety. Psalm 5 For the Chief Musician; with the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.

text.KJV: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
text.ASV: Give ear to my words, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.
text.WEB: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.

text.KJV: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
text.ASV: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.
text.WEB: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for to you do I pray.

text.KJV: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order `my prayer' unto thee, and will keep watch.
text.WEB: Yahweh, in the morning you shall hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

text.KJV: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
text.ASV: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.
text.WEB: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

text.KJV: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
text.ASV: The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
text.WEB: The arrogant shall not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

text.KJV: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
text.ASV: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.
text.WEB: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

text.KJV: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
text.ASV: But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house: In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
text.WEB: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

text.KJV: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
text.ASV: Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.
text.WEB: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

text.KJV: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
text.ASV: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.
text.WEB: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

text.KJV: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
text.ASV: Hold them guilty, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.
text.WEB: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

text.KJV: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
text.ASV: But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice, Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
text.WEB: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice, Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

text.KJV: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
text.ASV: For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield. Psalm 6 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

text.KJV: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
text.WEB: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

text.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
text.ASV: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.
text.WEB: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am faint. Yahweh, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

text.KJV: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
text.ASV: My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?
text.WEB: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?

text.KJV: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
text.ASV: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness' sake.
text.WEB: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

text.KJV: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
text.ASV: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?
text.WEB: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

text.KJV: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
text.ASV: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
text.WEB: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

text.KJV: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
text.ASV: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.
text.WEB: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

text.KJV: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
text.ASV: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.
text.WEB: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.

text.KJV: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.
text.WEB: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

text.KJV: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
text.ASV: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly. Psalm 7 Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto Jehova, concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite.
text.WEB: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

text.KJV: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
text.ASV: O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,
text.WEB: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

text.KJV: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
text.ASV: Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
text.WEB: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

text.KJV: O LORD my God, If I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
text.ASV: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;
text.WEB: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

text.KJV: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
text.ASV: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary;)
text.WEB: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),

text.KJV: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
text.ASV: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth, And lay my glory in the dust. Selah
text.WEB: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

text.KJV: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
text.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger; Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries, And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.
text.WEB: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

text.KJV: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
text.ASV: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.
text.WEB: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

text.KJV: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
text.ASV: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.
text.WEB: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

text.KJV: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
text.ASV: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.
text.WEB: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

text.KJV: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
text.ASV: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.
text.WEB: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

text.KJV: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
text.ASV: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.
text.WEB: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

text.KJV: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
text.ASV: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
text.WEB: If a man doesn’t relent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

text.KJV: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
text.ASV: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery `shafts'.
text.WEB: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

text.KJV: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
text.ASV: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
text.WEB: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

text.KJV: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
text.ASV: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.
text.WEB: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

text.KJV: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
text.ASV: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.
text.WEB: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

text.KJV: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
text.ASV: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High. Psalm 8 For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.

text.KJV: O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth, Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!
text.WEB: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth, who has set your glory above the heavens!

text.KJV: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
text.ASV: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established strength, Because of thine adversaries, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
text.WEB: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

text.KJV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
text.ASV: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
text.WEB: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;

text.KJV: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
text.ASV: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?
text.WEB: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

text.KJV: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
text.ASV: For thou hast made him but little lower than God, And crownest him with glory and honor.
text.WEB: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

text.KJV: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
text.ASV: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:
text.WEB: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

text.KJV: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
text.ASV: All sheep and oxen, Yea, and the beasts of the field,
text.WEB: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

text.KJV: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
text.ASV: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
text.WEB: The birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

text.KJV: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
text.ASV: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth! Psalm 9 For the Chief Musician; set to Muthlabben. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

text.KJV: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
text.ASV: I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.
text.WEB: I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

text.KJV: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
text.ASV: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.
text.WEB: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

text.KJV: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
text.ASV: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.
text.WEB: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

text.KJV: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
text.ASV: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.
text.WEB: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

text.KJV: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
text.ASV: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
text.WEB: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

text.KJV: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
text.ASV: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished.
text.WEB: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

text.KJV: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
text.ASV: But Jehovah sitteth `as king' for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment;
text.WEB: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

text.KJV: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
text.ASV: And he will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
text.WEB: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

text.KJV: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
text.ASV: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;
text.WEB: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

text.KJV: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
text.ASV: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
text.WEB: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

text.KJV: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
text.ASV: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.
text.WEB: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

text.KJV: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
text.ASV: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.
text.WEB: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

text.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
text.ASV: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction `which I suffer' of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;
text.WEB: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death;

text.KJV: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
text.ASV: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.
text.WEB: that I may show all of your praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion, I will rejoice in your salvation.

text.KJV: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
text.ASV: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
text.WEB: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

text.KJV: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah
text.WEB: Yahweh has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

text.KJV: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
text.ASV: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol, Even all the nations that forget God.
text.WEB: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

text.KJV: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
text.ASV: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.
text.WEB: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

text.KJV: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
text.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.
text.WEB: Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

text.KJV: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
text.ASV: Put them in fear, O Jehovah: Let the nations know themselves to be but men. Selah
text.WEB: Put them in fear, Yahweh. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

text.KJV: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
text.ASV: Why standest thou afar off, O Jehovah? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
text.WEB: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

text.KJV: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
text.ASV: In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.
text.WEB: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

text.KJV: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.
text.ASV: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, And the covetous renounceth, `yea', contemneth Jehovah.
text.WEB: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy, and condemns Yahweh.

text.KJV: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
text.ASV: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, `saith', He will not require `it'. All his thoughts are, There is no God.
text.WEB: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

text.KJV: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
text.ASV: His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.
text.WEB: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is haughty, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

text.KJV: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
text.ASV: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.
text.WEB: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

text.KJV: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
text.ASV: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
text.WEB: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

text.KJV: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
text.ASV: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.
text.WEB: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

text.KJV: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
text.ASV: He lurketh in secret as a lion in his covert; He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him in his net.
text.WEB: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless, when he draws him in his net.

text.KJV: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
text.ASV: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.
text.WEB: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

text.KJV: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
text.ASV: He saith in his heart, God hath forgotten; He hideth his face; he will never see it.
text.WEB: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

text.KJV: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
text.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.
text.WEB: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

text.KJV: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
text.ASV: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart, Thou wilt not require `it'?
text.WEB: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account?”

text.KJV: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
text.ASV: Thou hast seen `it'; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The helpless committeth `himself' unto thee; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.
text.WEB: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

text.KJV: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
text.ASV: Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
text.WEB: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

text.KJV: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
text.ASV: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.
text.WEB: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

text.KJV: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
text.ASV: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear;
text.WEB: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

text.KJV: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
text.ASV: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more. Psalm 11 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

text.KJV: In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
text.ASV: In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee `as' a bird to your mountain;
text.WEB: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain!”

text.KJV: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
text.ASV: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;
text.WEB: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

text.KJV: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
text.ASV: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?
text.WEB: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

text.KJV: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
text.ASV: Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
text.WEB: Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

text.KJV: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
text.ASV: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
text.WEB: Yahweh examines the righteous, but the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.

text.KJV: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
text.ASV: Upon the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.
text.WEB: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

text.KJV: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
text.ASV: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face. Psalm 12 For the Chief Musician; set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

text.KJV: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
text.ASV: Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
text.WEB: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

text.KJV: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
text.ASV: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.
text.WEB: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

text.KJV: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
text.ASV: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;
text.WEB: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

text.KJV: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
text.ASV: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
text.WEB: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

text.KJV: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
text.ASV: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.
text.WEB: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

text.KJV: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
text.ASV: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

text.KJV: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
text.ASV: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.
text.WEB: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

text.KJV: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
text.ASV: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men. Psalm 13 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

text.KJV: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
text.ASV: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
text.WEB: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

text.KJV: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
text.ASV: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
text.WEB: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

text.KJV: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
text.ASV: Consider `and' answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the `sleep of' death;
text.WEB: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

text.KJV: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
text.ASV: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; `Lest' mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
text.WEB: Lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him”; Lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

text.KJV: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
text.ASV: But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
text.WEB: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

text.KJV: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
text.ASV: I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me. Psalm 14 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.

text.KJV: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
text.ASV: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.
text.WEB: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

text.KJV: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
text.ASV: Jehovah looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.
text.WEB: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

text.KJV: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
text.ASV: They are all gone aside; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
text.WEB: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

text.KJV: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
text.ASV: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people `as' they eat bread, And call not upon Jehovah?
text.WEB: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?

text.KJV: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
text.ASV: There were they in great fear; For God is in the generation of the righteous.
text.WEB: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

text.KJV: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
text.ASV: Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor, Because Jehovah is his refuge.
text.WEB: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.

text.KJV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
text.ASV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, `and' Israel shall be glad. Psalm 15 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

text.KJV: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
text.ASV: Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
text.WEB: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

text.KJV: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
text.ASV: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;
text.WEB: He who walks blamelessly does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

text.KJV: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
text.ASV: He that slandereth not with his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his friend, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbor;
text.WEB: He who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

text.KJV: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
text.ASV: In whose eyes a reprobate is despised, But who honoreth them that fear Jehovah; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;
text.WEB: In whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear Yahweh; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

text.KJV: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
text.ASV: He that putteth not out his money to interest, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved. Psalm 16 Michtam of David.
text.WEB: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

text.KJV: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
text.ASV: Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.
text.WEB: Preserve me, God, for in you do I take refuge.

text.KJV: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
text.ASV: `O my soul', thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.
text.WEB: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

text.KJV: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
text.ASV: As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.
text.WEB: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

text.KJV: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
text.ASV: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another `god': Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.
text.WEB: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

text.KJV: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
text.ASV: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.
text.WEB: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

text.KJV: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
text.ASV: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.
text.WEB: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

text.KJV: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
text.ASV: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.
text.WEB: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

text.KJV: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
text.ASV: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
text.WEB: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

text.KJV: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
text.ASV: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; My flesh also shall dwell in safety.
text.WEB: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

text.KJV: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
text.ASV: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.
text.WEB: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

text.KJV: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
text.ASV: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore. Psalm 17 A Prayer of David.
text.WEB: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

text.KJV: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
text.ASV: Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
text.WEB: Hear, Yahweh, my righteous plea; Give ear to my prayer, that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

text.KJV: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
text.ASV: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes look upon equity.
text.WEB: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

text.KJV: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
text.ASV: Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
text.WEB: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

text.KJV: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
text.ASV: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.
text.WEB: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

text.KJV: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
text.ASV: My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.
text.WEB: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

text.KJV: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
text.ASV: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, `and' hear my speech.
text.WEB: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

text.KJV: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
text.ASV: Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that take refuge `in thee 'From those that rise up `against them'.
text.WEB: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

text.KJV: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
text.ASV: Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
text.WEB: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

text.KJV: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
text.ASV: From the wicked that oppress me, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.
text.WEB: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

text.KJV: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
text.ASV: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.
text.WEB: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

text.KJV: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
text.ASV: They have now compassed us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast `us' down to the earth.
text.WEB: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

text.KJV: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
text.ASV: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
text.WEB: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

text.KJV: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
text.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah, Confront him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked by thy sword;
text.WEB: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword;

text.KJV: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
text.ASV: From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in `this' life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
text.WEB: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

text.KJV: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
text.ASV: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with `beholding' thy form. Psalm 18 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of David the servant of Jehovah, who spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: and he said,
text.WEB: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

text.KJV: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
text.ASV: I love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.
text.WEB: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

text.KJV: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
text.ASV: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
text.WEB: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

text.KJV: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
text.ASV: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.
text.WEB: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

text.KJV: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
text.ASV: The cords of death compassed me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
text.WEB: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

text.KJV: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
text.ASV: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.
text.WEB: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

text.KJV: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
text.ASV: In my distress I called upon Jehovah, And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry before him came into his ears.
text.WEB: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

text.KJV: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
text.ASV: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the mountains quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.
text.WEB: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

text.KJV: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
text.ASV: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.
text.WEB: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

text.KJV: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
text.ASV: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.
text.WEB: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

text.KJV: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
text.ASV: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he soared upon the wings of the wind.
text.WEB: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

text.KJV: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
text.ASV: He made darkness his hiding-place, his pavilion round about him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
text.WEB: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

text.KJV: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
text.ASV: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, Hailstones and coals of fire.
text.WEB: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

text.KJV: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
text.ASV: Jehovah also thundered in the heavens, And the Most High uttered his voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.
text.WEB: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

text.KJV: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
text.ASV: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yea, lightnings manifold, and discomfited them.
text.WEB: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.

text.KJV: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
text.ASV: Then the channels of waters appeared, And the foundations of the world were laid bare, At thy rebuke, O Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
text.WEB: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

text.KJV: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
text.ASV: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters.
text.WEB: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

text.KJV: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
text.ASV: He delivered me from my strong enemy, And from them that hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
text.WEB: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

text.KJV: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
text.ASV: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.
text.WEB: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

text.KJV: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
text.ASV: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
text.WEB: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

text.KJV: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
text.WEB: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.

text.KJV: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
text.ASV: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
text.WEB: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

text.KJV: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
text.ASV: For all his ordinances were before me, And I put not away his statutes from me.
text.WEB: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

text.KJV: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
text.ASV: I was also perfect with him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.
text.WEB: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

text.KJV: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
text.ASV: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
text.WEB: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

text.KJV: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
text.ASV: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;
text.WEB: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

text.KJV: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
text.ASV: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.
text.WEB: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

text.KJV: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
text.ASV: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But the haughty eyes thou wilt bring down.
text.WEB: For you will save the afflicted people, but the haughty eyes you will bring down.

text.KJV: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
text.ASV: For thou wilt light my lamp: Jehovah my God will lighten my darkness.
text.WEB: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

text.KJV: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
text.ASV: For by thee I run upon a troop; And by my God do I leap over a wall.
text.WEB: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

text.KJV: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
text.ASV: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.
text.WEB: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

text.KJV: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
text.ASV: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, besides our God,
text.WEB: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

text.KJV: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
text.ASV: The God that girdeth me with strength, And maketh my way perfect?
text.WEB: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

text.KJV: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
text.ASV: He maketh my feet like hinds' `feet': And setteth me upon my high places.
text.WEB: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

text.KJV: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
text.ASV: He teacheth my hands to war; So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
text.WEB: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

text.KJV: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
text.ASV: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy right hand hath holden me up, And thy gentleness hath made me great.
text.WEB: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

text.KJV: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
text.ASV: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.
text.WEB: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

text.KJV: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
text.ASV: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; Neither will I turn again till they are consumed.
text.WEB: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. Neither will I turn again until they are consumed.

text.KJV: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
text.ASV: I will smite them through, so that they shall not be able to rise: They shall fall under my feet.
text.WEB: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

text.KJV: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
text.ASV: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
text.WEB: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

text.KJV: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
text.ASV: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.
text.WEB: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

text.KJV: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
text.ASV: They cried, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.
text.WEB: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

text.KJV: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
text.ASV: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.
text.WEB: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

text.KJV: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
text.ASV: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; Thou hast made me the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
text.WEB: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

text.KJV: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
text.ASV: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me; The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me.
text.WEB: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

text.KJV: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
text.ASV: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.
text.WEB: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their close places.

text.KJV: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
text.ASV: Jehovah liveth; and blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of my salvation,
text.WEB: Yahweh lives; and blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

text.KJV: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
text.ASV: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And subdueth peoples under me.
text.WEB: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

text.KJV: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
text.ASV: He rescueth me from mine enemies; Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
text.WEB: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

text.KJV: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
text.ASV: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.
text.WEB: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

text.KJV: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
text.ASV: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore. Psalm 19 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

text.KJV: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
text.ASV: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.
text.WEB: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

text.KJV: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
text.ASV: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.
text.WEB: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

text.KJV: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
text.ASV: There is no speech nor language; Their voice is not heard.
text.WEB: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

text.KJV: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
text.ASV: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
text.WEB: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

text.KJV: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
text.ASV: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.
text.WEB: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

text.KJV: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
text.ASV: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
text.WEB: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends; There is nothing hidden from its heat.

text.KJV: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
text.ASV: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s testimony is sure, making wise the simple.

text.KJV: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
text.ASV: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, `and' righteous altogether.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

text.KJV: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
text.ASV: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.
text.WEB: More to be desired are they than gold, yes, than much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

text.KJV: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
text.ASV: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.
text.WEB: Moreover by them is your servant warned. In keeping them there is great reward.

text.KJV: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
text.ASV: Who can discern `his' errors? Clear thou me from hidden `faults'.
text.WEB: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

text.KJV: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
text.ASV: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous `sins'; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.
text.WEB: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

text.KJV: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
text.ASV: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer. Psalm 20 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
