text.WEB: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

text.KJV: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
text.ASV: Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;
text.WEB: May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

text.KJV: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
text.ASV: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;
text.WEB: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

text.KJV: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
text.ASV: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt-sacrifice; Selah
text.WEB: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

text.KJV: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
text.ASV: Grant thee thy heart's desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.
text.WEB: May He grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

text.KJV: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
text.ASV: We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.
text.WEB: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.

text.KJV: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
text.ASV: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.
text.WEB: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

text.KJV: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
text.ASV: Some `trust' in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.
text.WEB: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of Yahweh our God.

text.KJV: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
text.ASV: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.
text.WEB: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

text.KJV: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
text.ASV: Save, Jehovah: Let the King answer us when we call. Psalm 21 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Save, Yahweh! Let the King answer us when we call!

text.KJV: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
text.ASV: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
text.WEB: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

text.KJV: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
text.ASV: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah
text.WEB: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

text.KJV: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
text.ASV: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.
text.WEB: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

text.KJV: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
text.ASV: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.
text.WEB: He asked life of you, you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

text.KJV: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
text.ASV: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.
text.WEB: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

text.KJV: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
text.ASV: For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.
text.WEB: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

text.KJV: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
text.ASV: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.
text.WEB: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

text.KJV: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
text.ASV: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.
text.WEB: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

text.KJV: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
text.ASV: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.
text.WEB: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

text.KJV: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
text.ASV: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.
text.WEB: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

text.KJV: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
text.ASV: For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.
text.WEB: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

text.KJV: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
text.ASV: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.
text.WEB: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

text.KJV: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
text.ASV: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power. Psalm 22 For the Chief Musician; set to Aijaleth hash-Shahar. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

text.KJV: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
text.ASV: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? `Why art thou so' far from helping me, `and from' the words of my groaning?
text.WEB: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

text.KJV: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
text.ASV: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou answerest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.
text.WEB: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

text.KJV: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
text.ASV: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
text.WEB: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

text.KJV: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
text.ASV: Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
text.WEB: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

text.KJV: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
text.ASV: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.
text.WEB: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

text.KJV: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
text.ASV: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.
text.WEB: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

text.KJV: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
text.ASV: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, `saying',
text.WEB: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

text.KJV: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
text.ASV: Commit `thyself' unto Jehovah; Let him deliver him: Let him rescue him, seeing he delighteth in him.
text.WEB: “He trusts in Yahweh. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

text.KJV: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
text.ASV: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; Thou didst make me trust `when I was' upon my mother's breasts.
text.WEB: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

text.KJV: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
text.ASV: I was cast upon thee from the womb; Thou art my God since my mother bare me.
text.WEB: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

text.KJV: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
text.ASV: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; For there is none to help.
text.WEB: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

text.KJV: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
text.ASV: Many bulls have compassed me; Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
text.WEB: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

text.KJV: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
text.ASV: They gape upon me with their mouth, `As' a ravening and a roaring lion.
text.WEB: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

text.KJV: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
text.ASV: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted within me.
text.WEB: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax; it is melted within me.

text.KJV: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
text.ASV: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
text.WEB: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

text.KJV: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
text.ASV: For dogs have compassed me: A company of evil-doers have inclosed me; They pierced my hands and my feet.
text.WEB: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

text.KJV: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
text.ASV: I may count all my bones; They look and stare upon me.
text.WEB: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

text.KJV: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
text.ASV: They part my garments among them, And upon my vesture do they cast lots.
text.WEB: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

text.KJV: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
text.ASV: But be not thou far off, O Jehovah: O thou my succor, haste thee to help me.
text.WEB: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help: hurry to help me.

text.KJV: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
text.ASV: Deliver my soul from the sword, My darling from the power of the dog.
text.WEB: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

text.KJV: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
text.ASV: Save me from the lion's mouth; Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen thou hast answered me.
text.WEB: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, from the horns of the wild oxen, you have answered me.

text.KJV: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
text.ASV: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: In the midst of the assembly will I praise thee.
text.WEB: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

text.KJV: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
text.ASV: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And stand in awe of him, all ye the seed of Israel.
text.WEB: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

text.KJV: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
text.ASV: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.
text.WEB: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

text.KJV: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
text.ASV: Of thee cometh my praise in the great assembly: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
text.WEB: Of you comes my praise in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

text.KJV: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
text.ASV: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; They shall praise Jehovah that seek after him: Let your heart live for ever.
text.WEB: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

text.KJV: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
text.ASV: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah; And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
text.WEB: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

text.KJV: For the kingdom is the LORD's: and he is the governor among the nations.
text.ASV: For the kingdom is Jehovah's; And he is the ruler over the nations.
text.WEB: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

text.KJV: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
text.ASV: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship: All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, Even he that cannot keep his soul alive.
text.WEB: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

text.KJV: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
text.ASV: A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the `next' generation.
text.WEB: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

text.KJV: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
text.ASV: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it. Psalm 23 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

text.KJV: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
text.ASV: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
text.WEB: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

text.KJV: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
text.ASV: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.
text.WEB: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

text.KJV: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
text.ASV: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
text.WEB: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

text.KJV: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
text.ASV: Yea, thou I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
text.WEB: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

text.KJV: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
text.ASV: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.
text.WEB: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

text.KJV: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
text.ASV: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever. Psalm 24 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

text.KJV: The earth is the LORD's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
text.ASV: The earth is Jehovah's, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
text.WEB: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

text.KJV: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
text.ASV: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.
text.WEB: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

text.KJV: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
text.ASV: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?
text.WEB: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

text.KJV: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
text.ASV: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.
text.WEB: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

text.KJV: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
text.ASV: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
text.WEB: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

text.KJV: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
text.ASV: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, `even' Jacob. Selah
text.WEB: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

text.KJV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
text.ASV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.
text.WEB: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

text.KJV: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
text.ASV: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.
text.WEB: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.

text.KJV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
text.ASV: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.
text.WEB: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

text.KJV: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
text.ASV: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. Selah Psalm 25 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

text.KJV: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
text.ASV: Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.
text.WEB: To you, Yahweh, do I lift up my soul.

text.KJV: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
text.ASV: O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
text.WEB: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

text.KJV: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
text.ASV: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.
text.WEB: Yes, no one who waits for you shall be shamed. They shall be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

text.KJV: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
text.ASV: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.
text.WEB: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.

text.KJV: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
text.ASV: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.
text.WEB: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.

text.KJV: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
text.ASV: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.
text.WEB: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

text.KJV: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
text.ASV: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness' sake, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
text.ASV: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.
text.WEB: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

text.KJV: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
text.ASV: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.
text.WEB: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

text.KJV: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
text.ASV: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
text.WEB: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

text.KJV: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
text.ASV: For thy name's sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.
text.WEB: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

text.KJV: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
text.ASV: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.
text.WEB: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

text.KJV: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
text.ASV: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the land.
text.WEB: His soul shall dwell at ease. His offspring shall inherit the land.

text.KJV: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
text.ASV: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him; And he will show them his covenant.
text.WEB: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

text.KJV: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
text.ASV: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.
text.WEB: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

text.KJV: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
text.ASV: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.
text.WEB: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

text.KJV: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
text.ASV: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.
text.WEB: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

text.KJV: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
text.ASV: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.
text.WEB: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

text.KJV: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
text.ASV: Consider mine enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.
text.WEB: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

text.KJV: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
text.ASV: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.
text.WEB: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

text.KJV: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
text.ASV: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for thee.
text.WEB: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

text.KJV: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
text.ASV: Redeem Israel, O God, Out all of his troubles. Psalm 26 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.

text.KJV: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
text.ASV: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.
text.WEB: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.

text.KJV: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
text.ASV: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.
text.WEB: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

text.KJV: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
text.ASV: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes; And I have walked in thy truth.
text.WEB: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

text.KJV: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
text.ASV: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.
text.WEB: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

text.KJV: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
text.ASV: I hate the assembly of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked.
text.WEB: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

text.KJV: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
text.ASV: I will wash my hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Jehovah;
text.WEB: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh;

text.KJV: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
text.ASV: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.
text.WEB: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

text.KJV: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
text.ASV: Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.
text.WEB: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

text.KJV: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
text.ASV: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;
text.WEB: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;

text.KJV: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
text.ASV: In whose hands is wickedness, And their right hand is full of bribes.
text.WEB: in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.

text.KJV: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
text.ASV: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
text.WEB: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

text.KJV: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
text.ASV: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless Jehovah. Psalm 27 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.

text.KJV: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
text.ASV: Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?
text.WEB: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

text.KJV: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
text.ASV: When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh, `Even' mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
text.WEB: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

text.KJV: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
text.ASV: Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, Even then will I be confident.
text.WEB: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

text.KJV: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
text.ASV: One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after; That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of Jehovah, And to inquire in his temple.
text.WEB: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

text.KJV: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
text.ASV: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion: In the covert of his tabernacle will he hide me; He will lift me up upon a rock.
text.WEB: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

text.KJV: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me. And I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me; I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
text.ASV: Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
text.WEB: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

text.KJV: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
text.ASV: `When thou saidst', Seek ye my face; My heart said unto thee, Thy face, Jehovah, will I seek.
text.WEB: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”

text.KJV: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
text.ASV: Hide not thy face from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
text.WEB: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

text.KJV: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
text.ASV: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then Jehovah will take me up.
text.WEB: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.

text.KJV: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
text.ASV: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; And lead me in a plain path, Because of mine enemies.
text.WEB: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

text.KJV: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
text.ASV: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries: For false witnesses are risen up against me, And such as breathe out cruelty.
text.WEB: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

text.KJV: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
text.ASV: `I had fainted', unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.
text.WEB: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

text.KJV: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
text.ASV: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah. Psalm 28 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

text.KJV: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
text.ASV: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
text.WEB: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me; lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

text.KJV: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
text.ASV: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
text.WEB: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

text.KJV: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
text.ASV: Draw me not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; That speak peace with their neighbors, But mischief is in their hearts.
text.WEB: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.

text.KJV: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
text.ASV: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings: Give them after the operation of their hands; Render to them their desert.
text.WEB: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

text.KJV: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
text.ASV: Because they regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.
text.WEB: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

text.KJV: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
text.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.
text.WEB: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

text.KJV: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
text.ASV: Jehovah is their strength, And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
text.WEB: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

text.KJV: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
text.ASV: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever. Psalm 29 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

text.KJV: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
text.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
text.WEB: Ascribe to Yahweh, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

text.KJV: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
text.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name; Worship Jehovah in holy array.
text.WEB: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

text.KJV: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.
text.ASV: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.

text.KJV: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
text.ASV: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.

text.KJV: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
text.ASV: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, Yahweh breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

text.KJV: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
text.ASV: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.
text.WEB: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

text.KJV: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
text.ASV: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

text.KJV: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
text.ASV: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s voice shakes the wilderness. Yahweh shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

text.KJV: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
text.ASV: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

text.KJV: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
text.ASV: Jehovah sat `as King' at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.
text.WEB: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.

text.KJV: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
text.ASV: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace. Psalm 30 A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House. `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.

text.KJV: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
text.ASV: I will extol thee, O Jehovah; for thou hast raised me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
text.WEB: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

text.KJV: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
text.ASV: O Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
text.WEB: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

text.KJV: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol; Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
text.WEB: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

text.KJV: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
text.ASV: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his, And give thanks to his holy memorial `name'.
text.WEB: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

text.KJV: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
text.ASV: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy `cometh' in the morning.
text.WEB: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

text.KJV: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
text.ASV: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.
text.WEB: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

text.KJV: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
text.ASV: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.
text.WEB: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

text.KJV: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
text.ASV: I cried to thee, O Jehovah; And unto Jehovah I made supplication:
text.WEB: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:

text.KJV: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
text.ASV: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
text.WEB: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

text.KJV: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
text.ASV: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me: Jehovah, be thou my helper.
text.WEB: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”

text.KJV: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
text.ASV: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
text.WEB: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

text.KJV: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
text.ASV: To the end that `my' glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Jehovah my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever. Psalm 31 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

text.KJV: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
text.ASV: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge; Let me never be put to shame: Deliver me in thy righteousness.
text.WEB: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

text.KJV: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
text.ASV: Bow down thine ear unto me; deliver me speedily: Be thou to me a strong rock, A house of defence to save me.
text.WEB: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

text.KJV: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
text.ASV: For thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for thy name's sake lead me and guide me.
text.WEB: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

text.KJV: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
text.ASV: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid privily for me; For thou art my stronghold.
text.WEB: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

text.KJV: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
text.ASV: Into thy hand I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Jehovah, thou God of truth.
text.WEB: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.

text.KJV: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
text.ASV: I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in Jehovah.
text.WEB: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.

text.KJV: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
text.ASV: I will be glad and rejoice in thy lovingkindness; For thou hast seen my affliction: Thou hast known my soul in adversities;
text.WEB: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

text.KJV: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
text.ASV: And thou hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a large place.
text.WEB: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

text.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
text.ASV: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah, for I am in distress: Mine eye wasteth away with grief, `yea', my soul and my body.
text.WEB: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

text.KJV: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
text.ASV: For my life is spent with sorrow, And my years with sighing: My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, And my bones are wasted away.
text.WEB: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

text.KJV: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
text.ASV: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbors exceedingly, And a fear to mine acquaintance: They that did see me without fled from me.
text.WEB: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

text.KJV: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
text.ASV: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
text.WEB: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

text.KJV: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
text.ASV: For I have heard the defaming of many, Terror on every side: While they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life.
text.WEB: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

text.KJV: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
text.ASV: But I trusted in thee, O Jehovah: I said, Thou art my God.
text.WEB: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”

text.KJV: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
text.ASV: My times are in thy hand: Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
text.WEB: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

text.KJV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
text.ASV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: Save me in thy lovingkindness.
text.WEB: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

text.KJV: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
text.ASV: Let me not be put to shame, O Jehovah; for I have called upon thee: Let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent in Sheol.
text.WEB: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

text.KJV: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
text.ASV: Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak against the righteous insolently, With pride and contempt.
text.WEB: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

text.KJV: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
text.ASV: Oh how great is thy goodness, Which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, Which thou hast wrought for them that take refuge in thee, Before the sons of men!
text.WEB: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

text.KJV: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
text.ASV: In the covert of thy presence wilt thou hide them from the plottings of man: Thou wilt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
text.WEB: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah; For he hath showed me his marvellous lovingkindness in a strong city.
text.WEB: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

text.KJV: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
text.ASV: As for me, I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: Nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications When I cried unto thee.
text.WEB: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

text.KJV: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
text.ASV: Oh love Jehovah, all ye his saints: Jehovah preserveth the faithful, And plentifully rewardeth him that dealeth proudly.
text.WEB: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

text.KJV: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
text.ASV: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that hope in Jehovah. Psalm 32 `A Psalm' of David. Maschil.
text.WEB: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.

text.KJV: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
text.ASV: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
text.WEB: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

text.KJV: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
text.ASV: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
text.WEB: Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

text.KJV: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
text.ASV: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.
text.WEB: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

text.KJV: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
text.ASV: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed `as' with the drought of summer. Selah
text.WEB: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

text.KJV: I acknowledge my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
text.ASV: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah
text.WEB: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to Yahweh, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

text.KJV: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
text.ASV: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.
text.WEB: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

text.KJV: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
text.ASV: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah
text.WEB: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

text.KJV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
text.ASV: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.
text.WEB: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

text.KJV: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
text.ASV: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, `Else' they will not come near unto thee.
text.WEB: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

text.KJV: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
text.ASV: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he that trusteth in Jehovah, lovingkindness shall compass him about.
text.WEB: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.

text.KJV: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
text.ASV: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
text.WEB: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

text.KJV: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
text.ASV: Rejoice in Jehovah, O ye righteous: Praise is comely for the upright.
text.WEB: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

text.KJV: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
text.ASV: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp: Sing praises unto him with the psaltery of ten strings.
text.WEB: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

text.KJV: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
text.ASV: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.
text.WEB: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

text.KJV: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
text.ASV: For the word of Jehovah is right; And all his work is `done' in faithfulness.
text.WEB: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

text.KJV: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
text.ASV: He loveth righteousness and justice: The earth is full of the lovingkindness of Jehovah.
text.WEB: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

text.KJV: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
text.ASV: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
text.WEB: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made; all their army by the breath of his mouth.

text.KJV: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
text.ASV: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the deeps in store-houses.
text.WEB: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

text.KJV: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
text.ASV: Let all the earth fear Jehovah: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
text.WEB: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

text.KJV: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
text.ASV: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.
text.WEB: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

text.KJV: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
text.ASV: Jehovah bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
text.WEB: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

text.KJV: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
text.ASV: The counsel of Jehovah standeth fast for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.
text.WEB: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

text.KJV: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
text.ASV: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
text.WEB: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

text.KJV: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
text.ASV: Jehovah looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;
text.WEB: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

text.KJV: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
text.ASV: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth Upon all the inhabitants of the earth,
text.WEB: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

text.KJV: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
text.ASV: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their works.
text.WEB: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

text.KJV: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
text.ASV: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
text.WEB: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

text.KJV: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
text.ASV: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth he deliver any by his great power.
text.WEB: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

text.KJV: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
text.ASV: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his lovingkindness;
text.WEB: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness;

text.KJV: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
text.ASV: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.
text.WEB: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

text.KJV: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
text.ASV: Our soul hath waited for Jehovah: He is our help and our shield.
text.WEB: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.

text.KJV: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
text.ASV: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.
text.WEB: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

text.KJV: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
text.ASV: Let thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, According as we have hoped in thee. Psalm 34 A Psalm of David; when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.
text.WEB: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.

text.KJV: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
text.ASV: I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
text.WEB: is an acrostic poem, with each verse starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav). I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

text.KJV: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
text.ASV: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah: The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.
text.WEB: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it, and be glad.

text.KJV: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
text.ASV: Oh magnify Jehovah with me, And let us exalt his name together.
text.WEB: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let us exalt his name together.

text.KJV: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
text.ASV: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.
text.WEB: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

text.KJV: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
text.ASV: They looked unto him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be confounded.
text.WEB: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

text.KJV: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
text.ASV: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.
text.WEB: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

text.KJV: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
text.ASV: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, And delivereth them.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

text.KJV: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
text.ASV: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.
text.WEB: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

text.KJV: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
text.ASV: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints; For there is no want to them that fear him.
text.WEB: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

text.KJV: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
text.ASV: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.
text.WEB: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

text.KJV: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
text.ASV: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

text.KJV: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
text.ASV: What man is he that desireth life, And loveth `many' days, that he may see good?
text.WEB: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

text.KJV: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
text.ASV: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.
text.WEB: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

text.KJV: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
text.ASV: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.
text.WEB: Depart from evil, and do good. seek peace, and pursue it.

text.KJV: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
text.ASV: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous, And his ears are `open' unto their cry.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

text.KJV: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
text.ASV: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

text.KJV: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
text.ASV: `The righteous' cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.
text.WEB: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

text.KJV: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
text.ASV: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.
text.WEB: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

text.KJV: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
text.ASV: Many are the afflictions of the righteous; But Jehovah delivereth him out of them all.
text.WEB: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

text.KJV: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
text.ASV: He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken.
text.WEB: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

text.KJV: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
text.ASV: Evil shall slay the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.
text.WEB: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

text.KJV: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
text.ASV: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned. Psalm 35 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

text.KJV: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
text.ASV: Strive thou, O Jehovah, with them that strive with me: Fight thou against them that fight against me.
text.WEB: Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

text.KJV: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
text.ASV: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.
text.WEB: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

text.KJV: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
text.ASV: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that pursue me: Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
text.WEB: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

text.KJV: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
text.ASV: Let them be put to shame and brought to dishonor that seek after my soul: Let them be turned back and confounded that devise my hurt.
text.WEB: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

text.KJV: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
text.ASV: Let them be as chaff before the wind, And the angel of Jehovah driving `them' on.
text.WEB: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.

text.KJV: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
text.ASV: Let their way be dark and slippery, And the angel of Jehovah pursuing them.
text.WEB: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.

text.KJV: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
text.ASV: For without cause have they hid for me their net `in' a pit; Without cause have they digged `a pit' for my soul.
text.WEB: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

text.KJV: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
text.ASV: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself: With destruction let him fall therein.
text.WEB: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

text.KJV: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
text.ASV: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah: It shall rejoice in his salvation.
text.WEB: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

text.KJV: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
text.ASV: All my bones shall say, Jehovah, who is like unto thee, Who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that robbeth him?
text.WEB: All my bones shall say, “Yahweh, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

text.KJV: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
text.ASV: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not.
text.WEB: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

text.KJV: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
text.ASV: They reward me evil for good, `To' the bereaving of my soul.
text.WEB: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

text.KJV: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
text.ASV: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
text.WEB: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

text.KJV: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
text.ASV: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother: I bowed down mourning, as one that bewaileth his mother.
text.WEB: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

text.KJV: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
text.ASV: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: The abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew `it' not; They did tear me, and ceased not:
text.WEB: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

text.KJV: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
text.ASV: Like the profane mockers in feasts, They gnashed upon me with their teeth.
text.WEB: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

text.KJV: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
text.ASV: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, My darling from the lions.
text.WEB: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

text.KJV: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
text.ASV: I will give thee thanks in the great assembly: I will praise thee among much people.
text.WEB: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

text.KJV: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
text.ASV: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
text.WEB: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

text.KJV: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
text.ASV: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful words against them that are quiet in the land.
text.WEB: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

text.KJV: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
text.ASV: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me; They said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
text.WEB: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

text.KJV: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
text.ASV: Thou hast seen it, O Jehovah; keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
text.WEB: You have seen it, Yahweh. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

text.KJV: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
text.ASV: Stir up thyself, and awake to the justice `due' unto me, `Even' unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
text.WEB: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

text.KJV: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
text.ASV: Judge me, O Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.
text.WEB: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

text.KJV: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
text.ASV: Let them not say in their heart, Aha, so would we have it: Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
text.WEB: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
