text.KJV: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
text.ASV: Let them be put to shame and confounded together that rejoice at my hurt: Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor that magnify themselves against me.
text.WEB: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

text.KJV: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
text.ASV: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favor my righteous cause: Yea, let them say continually, Jehovah be magnified, Who hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
text.WEB: Let them shout for joy and be glad, who favor my righteous cause. Yes, let them say continually, “Yahweh be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

text.KJV: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
text.ASV: And my tongue shall talk of thy righteousness `And' of thy praise all the day long. Psalm 36 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of David the servant of Jehovah.
text.WEB: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

text.KJV: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
text.ASV: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.
text.WEB: An inner sanctuary is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”

text.KJV: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
text.ASV: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, That his iniquity will not be found out and be hated.
text.WEB: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

text.KJV: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
text.ASV: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath ceased to be wise `and' to do good.
text.WEB: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

text.KJV: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
text.ASV: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.
text.WEB: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

text.KJV: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
text.ASV: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness `reacheth' unto the skies.
text.WEB: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

text.KJV: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
text.ASV: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Jehovah, thou preservest man and beast.
text.WEB: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

text.KJV: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
text.ASV: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.
text.WEB: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

text.KJV: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
text.ASV: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
text.WEB: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

text.KJV: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
text.ASV: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.
text.WEB: For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.

text.KJV: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
text.ASV: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee, And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
text.WEB: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

text.KJV: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
text.ASV: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
text.WEB: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

text.KJV: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
text.ASV: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise. Psalm 37 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

text.KJV: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
text.ASV: Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, Neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.
text.WEB: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

text.KJV: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
text.ASV: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.
text.WEB: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

text.KJV: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
text.ASV: Trust in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on `his' faithfulness.
text.WEB: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

text.KJV: Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
text.ASV: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.
text.WEB: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

text.KJV: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
text.ASV: Commit thy way unto Jehovah; Trust also in him, and he will bring it to pass.
text.WEB: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

text.KJV: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
text.ASV: And he will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, And thy justice as the noon-day.
text.WEB: he will make your righteousness go out as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

text.KJV: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
text.ASV: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
text.WEB: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

text.KJV: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
text.ASV: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself, `it tendeth' only to evil-doing.
text.WEB: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret, it leads only to evildoing.

text.KJV: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
text.ASV: For evil-doers shall be cut off; But those that wait for Jehovah, they shall inherit the land.
text.WEB: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

text.KJV: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
text.ASV: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and he shall not be.
text.WEB: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

text.KJV: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
text.ASV: But the meek shall inherit the land, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
text.WEB: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

text.KJV: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
text.ASV: The wicked plotteth against the just, And gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
text.WEB: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

text.KJV: The LORD shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
text.ASV: The Lord will laugh at him; For he seeth that his day is coming.
text.WEB: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

text.KJV: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
text.ASV: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay such as are upright in the way.
text.WEB: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

text.KJV: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
text.ASV: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.
text.WEB: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

text.KJV: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
text.ASV: Better is a little that the righteous hath Than the abundance of many wicked.
text.WEB: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

text.KJV: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
text.ASV: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; But Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.
text.WEB: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

text.KJV: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
text.ASV: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; And their inheritance shall be for ever.
text.WEB: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

text.KJV: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
text.ASV: They shall not be put to shame in the time of evil; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
text.WEB: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

text.KJV: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
text.ASV: But the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: They shall consume; In smoke shall they consume away.
text.WEB: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

text.KJV: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
text.ASV: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; But the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.
text.WEB: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

text.KJV: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
text.ASV: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the land; And they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.
text.WEB: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

text.KJV: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
text.ASV: A man's goings are established of Jehovah; And he delighteth in his way.
text.WEB: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

text.KJV: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
text.ASV: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For Jehovah upholdeth him with his hand.
text.WEB: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

text.KJV: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
text.ASV: I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his seed begging bread.
text.WEB: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

text.KJV: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
text.ASV: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed.
text.WEB: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

text.KJV: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
text.ASV: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore.
text.WEB: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

text.KJV: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
text.ASV: For Jehovah loveth justice, And forsaketh not his saints; They are preserved for ever: But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
text.WEB: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

text.KJV: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
text.ASV: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever.
text.WEB: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

text.KJV: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
text.ASV: The mouth of the righteous talketh of wisdom, And his tongue speaketh justice.
text.WEB: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

text.KJV: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
text.ASV: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.
text.WEB: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

text.KJV: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
text.ASV: The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him.
text.WEB: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.

text.KJV: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
text.ASV: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.
text.WEB: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

text.KJV: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
text.ASV: Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, And he will exalt thee to inherit the land: When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
text.WEB: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

text.KJV: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
text.ASV: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
text.WEB: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

text.KJV: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
text.ASV: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
text.WEB: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

text.KJV: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
text.ASV: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright; For there is a `happy' end to the man of peace.
text.WEB: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

text.KJV: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
text.ASV: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together; The end of the wicked shall be cut off.
text.WEB: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

text.KJV: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
text.ASV: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
text.WEB: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

text.KJV: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
text.ASV: And Jehovah helpeth them, and rescueth them; He rescueth them from the wicked, and saveth them, Because they have taken refuge in him. Psalm 38 A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.
text.WEB: Yahweh helps them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them, Because they have taken refuge in him.

text.KJV: O lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
text.WEB: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

text.KJV: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
text.ASV: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.
text.WEB: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

text.KJV: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
text.ASV: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
text.WEB: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

text.KJV: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
text.ASV: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
text.WEB: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

text.KJV: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
text.ASV: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, Because of my foolishness.
text.WEB: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.

text.KJV: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
text.ASV: I am pained and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
text.WEB: I am pained and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

text.KJV: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
text.ASV: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.
text.WEB: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

text.KJV: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
text.ASV: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
text.WEB: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

text.KJV: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
text.ASV: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.
text.WEB: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

text.KJV: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
text.ASV: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
text.WEB: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

text.KJV: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
text.ASV: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.
text.WEB: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

text.KJV: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
text.ASV: They also that seek after my life lay snares `for me'; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.
text.WEB: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

text.KJV: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
text.ASV: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
text.WEB: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

text.KJV: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
text.ASV: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.
text.WEB: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

text.KJV: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
text.ASV: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.
text.WEB: For in you, Yahweh, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.

text.KJV: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
text.ASV: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
text.WEB: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

text.KJV: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
text.ASV: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.
text.WEB: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

text.KJV: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
text.ASV: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
text.WEB: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

text.KJV: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
text.ASV: But mine enemies are lively, `and' are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
text.WEB: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

text.KJV: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
text.ASV: They also that render evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.
text.WEB: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

text.KJV: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
text.ASV: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.
text.WEB: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.

text.KJV: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
text.ASV: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation. Psalm 39 For the Chief Musician, Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

text.KJV: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
text.ASV: I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.
text.WEB: I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

text.KJV: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
text.ASV: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.
text.WEB: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

text.KJV: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
text.ASV: My heart was hot within me; While I was musing the fire burned: `Then' spake I with my tongue:
text.WEB: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

text.KJV: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.
text.ASV: Jehovah, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how frail I am.
text.WEB: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

text.KJV: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
text.ASV: Behold, thou hast made my days `as' handbreadths; And my life-time is as nothing before thee: Surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. Selah
text.WEB: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

text.KJV: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
text.ASV: Surely every man walketh in a vain show; Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up `riches', and knoweth not who shall gather them.
text.WEB: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

text.KJV: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
text.ASV: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.
text.WEB: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

text.KJV: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
text.ASV: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.
text.WEB: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

text.KJV: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
text.ASV: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.
text.WEB: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

text.KJV: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
text.ASV: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.
text.WEB: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

text.KJV: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
text.ASV: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity. Selah
text.WEB: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, You consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

text.KJV: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
text.ASV: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.
text.WEB: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

text.KJV: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
text.ASV: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more. Psalm 40 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more.”

text.KJV: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
text.ASV: I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
text.WEB: I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

text.KJV: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
text.ASV: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay; And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
text.WEB: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

text.KJV: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
text.ASV: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.
text.WEB: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.

text.KJV: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
text.ASV: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
text.WEB: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

text.KJV: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
text.ASV: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward; They cannot be set in order unto thee; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.
text.WEB: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

text.KJV: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
text.ASV: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not required.
text.WEB: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

text.KJV: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
text.ASV: Then said I, Lo, I am come; In the roll of the book it is written of me:
text.WEB: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

text.KJV: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
text.ASV: I delight to do thy will, O my God; Yea, thy law is within my heart.
text.WEB: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

text.KJV: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
text.ASV: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly; Lo, I will not refrain my lips, O Jehovah, thou knowest.
text.WEB: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

text.KJV: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
text.ASV: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation; I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great assembly.
text.WEB: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

text.KJV: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
text.ASV: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah; Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
text.WEB: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

text.KJV: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
text.ASV: For innumerable evils have compassed me about; Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; And my heart hath failed me.
text.WEB: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

text.KJV: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
text.ASV: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
text.ASV: Let them be put to shame and confounded together That seek after my soul to destroy it: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.
text.WEB: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

text.KJV: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
text.ASV: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.
text.WEB: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

text.KJV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
text.ASV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified.
text.WEB: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”

text.KJV: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
text.ASV: But I am poor and needy; `Yet' the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God. Psalm 41 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

text.KJV: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
text.ASV: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.
text.WEB: Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

text.KJV: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
text.ASV: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive, And he shall be blessed upon the earth; And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.
text.WEB: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

text.KJV: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
text.ASV: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.
text.WEB: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

text.KJV: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
text.ASV: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me: Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
text.WEB: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

text.KJV: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
text.ASV: Mine enemies speak evil against me, `saying', When will he die, and his name perish?
text.WEB: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

text.KJV: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
text.ASV: And if he come to see `me', he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself: When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
text.WEB: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

text.KJV: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
text.ASV: All that hate me whisper together against me; Against me do they devise my hurt.
text.WEB: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

text.KJV: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
text.ASV: An evil disease, `say they', cleaveth fast unto him; And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
text.WEB: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

text.KJV: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
text.ASV: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.
text.WEB: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

text.KJV: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
text.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.
text.WEB: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

text.KJV: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
text.ASV: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
text.WEB: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

text.KJV: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
text.ASV: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.
text.WEB: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen. Psalm 42 For the Chief Musician. Maschil of the sons of Korah.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

text.KJV: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
text.ASV: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
text.WEB: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

text.KJV: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
text.ASV: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: When shall I come and appear before God?
text.WEB: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

text.KJV: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
text.ASV: My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
text.WEB: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

text.KJV: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
text.ASV: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, How I went with the throng, and led them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday.
text.WEB: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

text.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
text.ASV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And `why' art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him `For' the help of his countenance.
text.WEB: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

text.KJV: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
text.ASV: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: Therefore do I remember thee from the land of the Jordan, And the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.
text.WEB: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

text.KJV: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
text.ASV: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterfalls: All thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
text.WEB: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

text.KJV: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
text.ASV: `Yet' Jehovah will command his lovingkindness in the day-time; And in the night his song shall be with me, `Even' a prayer unto the God of my life.
text.WEB: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

text.KJV: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
text.ASV: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
text.WEB: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

text.KJV: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
text.ASV: As with a sword in my bones, mine adversaries reproach me, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
text.WEB: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

text.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
text.ASV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, `Who is' the help of my countenance, and my God.
text.WEB: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

text.KJV: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
text.ASV: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
text.WEB: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

text.KJV: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
text.ASV: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
text.WEB: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

text.KJV: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
text.ASV: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.
text.WEB: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, To your tents.

text.KJV: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
text.ASV: Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.
text.WEB: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

text.KJV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
text.ASV: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, `Who is' the help of my countenance, and my God. Psalm 44 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of the sons of Korah. Maschil.
text.WEB: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

text.KJV: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
text.ASV: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.
text.WEB: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

text.KJV: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
text.ASV: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.
text.WEB: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

text.KJV: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
text.ASV: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.
text.WEB: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

text.KJV: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
text.ASV: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverance for Jacob.
text.WEB: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!

text.KJV: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
text.ASV: Through thee will we push down our adversaries: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
text.WEB: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.

text.KJV: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
text.ASV: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.
text.WEB: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

text.KJV: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
text.ASV: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries, And hast put them to shame that hate us.
text.WEB: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

text.KJV: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
text.ASV: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. Selah
text.WEB: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

text.KJV: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
text.ASV: But now thou hast cast `us' off, and brought us to dishonor, And goest not forth with our hosts.
text.WEB: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

text.KJV: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
text.ASV: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.
text.WEB: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

text.KJV: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
text.ASV: Thou hast made us like sheep `appointed' for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.
text.WEB: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

text.KJV: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
text.ASV: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And hast not increased `thy wealth' by their price.
text.WEB: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

text.KJV: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
text.ASV: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.
text.WEB: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

text.KJV: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
text.ASV: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.
text.WEB: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

text.KJV: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
text.ASV: All the day long is my dishonor before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,
text.WEB: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

text.KJV: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
text.ASV: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, By reason of the enemy and the avenger.
text.WEB: At the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

text.KJV: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
text.ASV: All this is come upon us; Yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
text.WEB: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.

text.KJV: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
text.ASV: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way,
text.WEB: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

text.KJV: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
text.ASV: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.
text.WEB: Though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

text.KJV: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
text.ASV: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;
text.WEB: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god;

text.KJV: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
text.ASV: Will not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
text.WEB: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

text.KJV: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
text.ASV: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
text.WEB: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

text.KJV: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
text.ASV: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast `us' not off for ever.
text.WEB: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

text.KJV: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
text.ASV: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
text.WEB: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

text.KJV: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
text.ASV: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.
text.WEB: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

text.KJV: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
text.ASV: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness' sake. Psalm 45 For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. `A Psalm' of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves.
text.WEB: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

text.KJV: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
text.ASV: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I speak the things which I have made touching the king: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
text.WEB: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

text.KJV: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
text.ASV: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
text.WEB: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

text.KJV: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
text.ASV: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.
text.WEB: Strap your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.

text.KJV: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
text.ASV: And in thy majesty ride on prosperously, Because of truth and meekness `and' righteousness: And thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
text.WEB: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

text.KJV: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
text.ASV: Thine arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under thee; `They are' in the heart of the king's enemies.
text.WEB: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

text.KJV: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
text.ASV: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
text.WEB: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

text.KJV: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
text.ASV: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness: Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
text.WEB: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

text.KJV: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
text.ASV: All thy garments `smell of' myrrh, and aloes, `and' cassia; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.
text.WEB: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

text.KJV: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
text.ASV: Kings' daughters are among thy honorable women: At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
text.WEB: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

text.KJV: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
text.ASV: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father's house:
text.WEB: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

text.KJV: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
text.ASV: So will the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; and reverence thou him.
text.WEB: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

text.KJV: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
text.ASV: And the daughter of Tyre `shall be there' with a gift; The rich among the people shall entreat thy favor.
text.WEB: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

text.KJV: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
text.ASV: The king's daughter within `the palace' is all glorious: Her clothing is inwrought with gold.
text.WEB: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

text.KJV: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
text.ASV: She shall be led unto the king in broidered work: The virgins her companions that follow her Shall be brought unto thee.
text.WEB: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

text.KJV: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
text.ASV: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: They shall enter into the king's palace.
text.WEB: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

text.KJV: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
text.ASV: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.
text.WEB: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

text.KJV: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
text.ASV: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: Therefore shall the peoples give thee thanks for ever and ever. Psalm 46 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of the sons of Korah; set to Alamoth. A Song.
text.WEB: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

text.KJV: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
text.ASV: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
text.WEB: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

text.KJV: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
text.ASV: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;
text.WEB: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

text.KJV: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
text.ASV: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. Selah
text.WEB: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

text.KJV: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
text.ASV: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacles of the Most High.
text.WEB: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

text.KJV: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
text.ASV: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God will help her, and that right early.
text.WEB: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

text.KJV: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
text.ASV: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered his voice, the earth melted.
text.WEB: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.

text.KJV: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
text.ASV: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah
text.WEB: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

text.KJV: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
text.ASV: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.
text.WEB: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.

text.KJV: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
text.ASV: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.
text.WEB: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

text.KJV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
text.ASV: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.
text.WEB: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

text.KJV: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
text.ASV: Jehovah of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah Psalm 47 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
text.WEB: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

text.KJV: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
text.ASV: Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
text.WEB: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

text.KJV: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
text.ASV: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.
text.WEB: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

text.KJV: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
text.ASV: He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.
text.WEB: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

text.KJV: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
text.ASV: He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah
text.WEB: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

text.KJV: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
text.ASV: God is gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.
text.WEB: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

text.KJV: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
text.ASV: Sing praise to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
text.WEB: Sing praises to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.

text.KJV: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
text.ASV: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.
text.WEB: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

text.KJV: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
text.ASV: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.
text.WEB: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

text.KJV: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
text.ASV: The princes of the peoples are gathered together `To be' the people of the God of Abraham: For the shields of the earth belong unto God; He is greatly exalted. Psalm 48 A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.
text.WEB: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

text.KJV: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
text.ASV: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
text.WEB: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

text.KJV: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
text.ASV: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is mount Zion, `on' the sides of the north, The city of the great King.
text.WEB: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

text.KJV: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
text.ASV: God hath made himself known in her palaces for a refuge.
text.WEB: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

text.KJV: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
text.ASV: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.
text.WEB: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

text.KJV: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
text.ASV: They saw it, then were they amazed; They were dismayed, they hasted away.
text.WEB: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

text.KJV: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
text.ASV: Trembling took hold of them there, Pain, as of a woman in travail.
text.WEB: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

text.KJV: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
text.ASV: With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.
text.WEB: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

text.KJV: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
text.ASV: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of Jehovah of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah
text.WEB: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

text.KJV: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
text.ASV: We have thought on thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of thy temple.
text.WEB: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

text.KJV: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
text.ASV: As is thy name, O God, So is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
text.WEB: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

text.KJV: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
text.ASV: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of thy judgments.
text.WEB: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of your judgments.

text.KJV: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
text.ASV: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Number the towers thereof;
text.WEB: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

text.KJV: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
text.ASV: Mark ye well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces: That ye may tell it to the generation following.
text.WEB: Mark well her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

text.KJV: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
text.ASV: For this God is our God for ever and ever: He will be our guide `even' unto death. Psalm 49 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
text.WEB: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

text.KJV: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
text.ASV: Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,
text.WEB: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

text.KJV: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
text.ASV: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
text.WEB: both low and high, rich and poor together.

text.KJV: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
text.ASV: My mouth shall speak wisdom; And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
text.WEB: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart shall utter understanding.

text.KJV: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
text.ASV: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
text.WEB: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will open my riddle on the harp.

text.KJV: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
text.ASV: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?
text.WEB: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

text.KJV: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
text.ASV: They that trust in their wealth, And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
text.WEB: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

text.KJV: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
text.ASV: None `of them' can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him;
text.WEB: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

text.KJV: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
text.ASV: (For the redemption of their life is costly, And it faileth for ever;)
text.WEB: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

text.KJV: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
text.ASV: That he should still live alway, That he should not see corruption.
text.WEB: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

text.KJV: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
text.ASV: For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.
text.WEB: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

text.KJV: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
text.ASV: Their inward thought is, `that' their houses `shall continue' for ever, `And' their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.
text.WEB: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

text.KJV: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
text.ASV: But man `being' in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.
text.WEB: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

text.KJV: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
text.ASV: This their way is their folly: Yet after them men approve their sayings. Selah
text.WEB: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

text.KJV: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
text.ASV: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd; And the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their beauty shall be for Sheol to consume, That there be no habitation for it.
text.WEB: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

text.KJV: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
text.ASV: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol; For he will receive me. Selah
text.WEB: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

text.KJV: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
text.ASV: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, When the glory of his house is increased.
text.WEB: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

text.KJV: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
text.ASV: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.
text.WEB: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

text.KJV: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
text.ASV: Though while he lived he blessed his soul (And men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself,)
text.WEB: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

text.KJV: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
text.ASV: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light.
text.WEB: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

text.KJV: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
text.ASV: Man that is in honor, and understandeth not, Is like the beasts that perish. Psalm 50 A Psalm of Asaph.
text.WEB: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

text.KJV: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
text.ASV: The Mighty One, God, Jehovah, hath spoken, And called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
text.WEB: The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

text.KJV: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
text.ASV: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.
text.WEB: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

text.KJV: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
text.ASV: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence: A fire devoureth before him, And it is very tempestuous round about him.
text.WEB: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

text.KJV: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
text.ASV: He calleth to the heavens above, And to the earth, that he may judge his people:
text.WEB: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

text.KJV: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
text.ASV: Gather my saints together unto me, Those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
text.WEB: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

text.KJV: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
text.ASV: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness; For God is judge himself. Selah
text.WEB: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

text.KJV: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
text.ASV: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, `even' thy God.
text.WEB: “Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

text.KJV: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
text.ASV: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; And thy burnt-offerings are continually before me.
text.WEB: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

text.KJV: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
text.ASV: I will take no bullock out of thy house, Nor he-goats out of thy folds.
text.WEB: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

text.KJV: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
text.ASV: For every beast of the forest is mine, And the cattle upon a thousand hills.
text.WEB: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

text.KJV: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
text.ASV: I know all the birds of the mountains; And the wild beasts of the field are mine.
text.WEB: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

text.KJV: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
text.ASV: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; For the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
text.WEB: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

text.KJV: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
text.ASV: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?
text.WEB: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

text.KJV: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
text.ASV: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; And pay thy vows unto the Most High:
text.WEB: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

text.KJV: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
text.ASV: And call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
text.WEB: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
