text.KJV: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
text.ASV: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, And that thou hast taken my covenant in thy mouth,
text.WEB: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

text.KJV: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and casteth my words behind thee.
text.ASV: Seeing thou hatest instruction, And castest my words behind thee?
text.WEB: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

text.KJV: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
text.ASV: When thou sawest a thief, thou consentedst with him, And hast been partaker with adulterers.
text.WEB: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

text.KJV: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
text.ASV: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, And thy tongue frameth deceit.
text.WEB: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

text.KJV: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
text.ASV: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
text.WEB: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

text.KJV: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
text.ASV: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such a one as thyself: `But' I will reprove thee, and set `them' in order before thine eyes.
text.WEB: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

text.KJV: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
text.ASV: Now consider this, ye that forget God, Lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver:
text.WEB: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

text.KJV: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
text.ASV: Whoso offereth the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifieth me; And to him that ordereth his way `aright' Will I show the salvation of God. Psalm 51 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
text.WEB: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

text.KJV: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
text.ASV: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
text.WEB: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

text.KJV: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
text.ASV: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.
text.WEB: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

text.KJV: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
text.ASV: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.
text.WEB: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

text.KJV: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
text.ASV: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in thy sight; That thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, And be clear when thou judgest.
text.WEB: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

text.KJV: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
text.ASV: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity; And in sin did my mother conceive me.
text.WEB: Behold, I was born in iniquity. In sin my mother conceived me.

text.KJV: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
text.ASV: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.
text.WEB: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

text.KJV: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
text.ASV: Purify me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
text.WEB: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

text.KJV: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
text.ASV: Make me to hear joy and gladness, That the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
text.WEB: Let me hear joy and gladness, That the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

text.KJV: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
text.ASV: Hide thy face from my sins, And blot out all mine iniquities.
text.WEB: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

text.KJV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
text.ASV: Create in me a clean heart, O God; And renew a right spirit within me.
text.WEB: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

text.KJV: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
text.ASV: Cast me not away from thy presence; And take not thy holy Spirit from me.
text.WEB: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your holy Spirit from me.

text.KJV: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
text.ASV: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; And uphold me with a willing spirit.
text.WEB: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

text.KJV: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
text.ASV: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; And sinners shall be converted unto thee.
text.WEB: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.

text.KJV: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
text.ASV: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation; `And' my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
text.WEB: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.

text.KJV: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
text.ASV: O Lord, open thou my lips; And my mouth shall show forth thy praise.
text.WEB: Lord, open my lips. My mouth shall declare your praise.

text.KJV: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
text.ASV: For thou delightest not in sacrifice; else would I give it: Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.
text.WEB: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

text.KJV: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
text.ASV: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: A broken and contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
text.WEB: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

text.KJV: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
text.ASV: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: Build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
text.WEB: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

text.KJV: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
text.ASV: Then will thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, In burnt-offering and in whole burnt-offering: Then will they offer bullocks upon thine altar. Psalm 52 For the Chief Musician. Maschil of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Abimelech.
text.WEB: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

text.KJV: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
text.ASV: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God `endureth' continually.
text.WEB: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

text.KJV: The tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
text.ASV: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
text.WEB: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

text.KJV: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
text.ASV: Thou lovest evil more than good, And lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah
text.WEB: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

text.KJV: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
text.ASV: Thou lovest all devouring words, thou deceitful tongue.
text.WEB: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

text.KJV: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
text.ASV: God will likewise destroy thee for ever; He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. Selah
text.WEB: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

text.KJV: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
text.ASV: The righteous also shall see `it', and fear, And shall laugh at him, `saying',
text.WEB: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

text.KJV: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
text.ASV: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.
text.WEB: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

text.KJV: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
text.ASV: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I trust in the lovingkindness of God for ever and ever.
text.WEB: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

text.KJV: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
text.ASV: I will give thee thanks for ever, because thou hast done it; And I will hope in thy name, for it is good, in the presence of thy saints. Psalm 53 For the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath. Maschil of David.
text.WEB: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

text.KJV: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
text.ASV: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good.
text.WEB: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

text.KJV: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
text.ASV: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.
text.WEB: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

text.KJV: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
text.ASV: Every one of them is gone back; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
text.WEB: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

text.KJV: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
text.ASV: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people `as' they eat bread, And call not upon God?
text.WEB: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

text.KJV: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
text.ASV: There were they in great fear, where no fear was; For God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: Thou hast put them to shame, because of God hath rejected them.
text.WEB: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

text.KJV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
text.ASV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, `and' Israel shall be glad. Psalm 54 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David; when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?
text.WEB: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

text.KJV: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
text.ASV: Save me, O God, by thy name, And judge me in thy might.
text.WEB: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

text.KJV: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
text.ASV: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.
text.WEB: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

text.KJV: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
text.ASV: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. Selah
text.WEB: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

text.KJV: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
text.ASV: Behold, God is my helper: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.
text.WEB: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

text.KJV: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
text.ASV: He will requite the evil unto mine enemies: Destroy thou them in thy truth.
text.WEB: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

text.KJV: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
text.ASV: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee: I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.
text.WEB: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.

text.KJV: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
text.ASV: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath seen `my desire' upon mine enemies. Psalm 55 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David.
text.WEB: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

text.KJV: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
text.ASV: Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.
text.WEB: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

text.KJV: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
text.ASV: Attend unto me, and answer me: I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
text.WEB: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

text.KJV: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
text.ASV: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast iniquity upon me, And in anger they persecute me.
text.WEB: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

text.KJV: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
text.ASV: My heart is sore pained within me: And the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
text.WEB: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

text.KJV: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
text.ASV: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, And horror hath overwhelmed me.
text.WEB: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

text.KJV: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
text.ASV: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.
text.WEB: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

text.KJV: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
text.ASV: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah
text.WEB: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

text.KJV: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
text.ASV: I would haste me to a shelter From the stormy wind and tempest.
text.WEB: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

text.KJV: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
text.ASV: Destroy, O Lord, `and' divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
text.WEB: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

text.KJV: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
text.ASV: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.
text.WEB: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

text.KJV: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
text.ASV: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.
text.WEB: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

text.KJV: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
text.ASV: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; Then I could have borne it: Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; Then I would have hid myself from him:
text.WEB: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

text.KJV: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
text.ASV: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend.
text.WEB: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

text.KJV: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
text.ASV: We took sweet counsel together; We walked in the house of God with the throng.
text.WEB: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

text.KJV: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
text.ASV: Let death come suddenly upon them, Let them go down alive into Sheol; For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.
text.WEB: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

text.KJV: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
text.ASV: As for me, I will call upon God; And Jehovah will save me.
text.WEB: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.

text.KJV: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
text.ASV: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan; And he will hear my voice.
text.WEB: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

text.KJV: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
text.ASV: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me; For they were many `that strove' with me.
text.WEB: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

text.KJV: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
text.ASV: God will hear, and answer them, Even he that abideth of old, Selah `The men' who have no changes, And who fear not God.
text.WEB: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don’t fear God.

text.KJV: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
text.ASV: He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him: He hath profaned his covenant.
text.WEB: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

text.KJV: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
text.ASV: His mouth was smooth as butter, But his heart was war: His words were softer than oil, Yet were they drawn swords.
text.WEB: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

text.KJV: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
text.ASV: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
text.WEB: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

text.KJV: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
text.ASV: But thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in thee. Psalm 56 For the Chief Musician; set to Jonath elem rehokim. `A Psalm' of David. Michtam: when the Philistines took him in Gath.
text.WEB: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

text.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
text.ASV: Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me.
text.WEB: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

text.KJV: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
text.ASV: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long; For they are many that fight proudly against me.
text.WEB: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

text.KJV: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
text.ASV: What time I am afraid, I will put my trust in thee.
text.WEB: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

text.KJV: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
text.ASV: In God (I will praise his word), In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?
text.WEB: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

text.KJV: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
text.ASV: All the day long they wrest my words: All their thoughts are against me for evil.
text.WEB: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

text.KJV: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
text.ASV: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps, Even as they have waited for my soul.
text.WEB: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps, they are eager to take my life.

text.KJV: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
text.ASV: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.
text.WEB: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

text.KJV: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
text.ASV: Thou numberest my wanderings: Put thou my tears into thy bottle; Are they not in thy book?
text.WEB: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren’t they in your book?

text.KJV: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
text.ASV: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call: This I know, that God is for me.
text.WEB: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.

text.KJV: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
text.ASV: In God (I will praise `his' word), In Jehovah (I will praise `his' word),
text.WEB: In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.

text.KJV: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
text.ASV: In God have I put my trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?
text.WEB: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

text.KJV: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
text.ASV: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thank-offerings unto thee.
text.WEB: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

text.KJV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
text.ASV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: `Hast thou' not `delivered' my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living? Psalm 57 For the Chief Musician; `set to' Al-tash-heth. `A Psalm' of David. Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
text.WEB: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

text.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
text.ASV: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me; For my soul taketh refuge in thee: Yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I take refuge, Until `these' calamities be overpast.
text.WEB: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

text.KJV: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
text.ASV: I will cry unto God Most High, Unto God that performeth `all things' for me.
text.WEB: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

text.KJV: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
text.ASV: He will send from heaven, and save me, `When' he that would swallow me up reproacheth; Selah God will send forth his lovingkindness and his truth.
text.WEB: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

text.KJV: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
text.ASV: My soul is among lions; I lie among them that are set on fire, Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.
text.WEB: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

text.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
text.ASV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; `Let' thy glory `be' above all the earth.
text.WEB: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

text.KJV: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
text.ASV: They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down: They have digged a pit before me; They are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. Selah
text.WEB: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

text.KJV: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
text.ASV: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.
text.WEB: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

text.KJV: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
text.ASV: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
text.WEB: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

text.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
text.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the peoples: I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
text.WEB: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

text.KJV: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
text.ASV: For thy lovingkindness is great unto the heavens, And thy truth unto the skies.
text.WEB: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

text.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
text.ASV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; `Let' thy glory `be' above all the earth. Psalm 58 For the Chief Musician; `set to' Al-tashheth. `A Psalm' of David Michtam.
text.WEB: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

text.KJV: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
text.ASV: Do ye indeed in silence speak righteousness? Do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
text.WEB: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

text.KJV: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
text.ASV: Nay, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.
text.WEB: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

text.KJV: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
text.ASV: The wicked are estranged from the womb: They go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
text.WEB: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

text.KJV: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
text.ASV: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: `They are' like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear,
text.WEB: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

text.KJV: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
text.ASV: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, Charming never so wisely.
text.WEB: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

text.KJV: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
text.ASV: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: Break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
text.ASV: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace: When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.
text.WEB: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

text.KJV: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
text.ASV: `Let them be' as a snail which melteth and passeth away, `Like' the untimely birth of a woman, that hath not seen the sun.
text.WEB: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

text.KJV: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
text.ASV: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will take them away with a whirlwind, the green and the burning alike.
text.WEB: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

text.KJV: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
text.ASV: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;
text.WEB: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

text.KJV: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
text.ASV: So that men shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth. Psalm 59 For the Chief Musician; `set to' Al-tashheth. `A Psalm' of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
text.WEB: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

text.KJV: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
text.ASV: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: Set me on high from them that rise up against me.
text.WEB: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

text.KJV: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
text.ASV: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from the bloodthirsty men.
text.WEB: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

text.KJV: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
text.ASV: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; The mighty gather themselves together against me: Not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

text.KJV: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
text.ASV: They run and prepare themselves without `my' fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.
text.WEB: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

text.KJV: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
text.ASV: Even thou, O Jehovah God of hosts, the God of Israel, Arise to visit all the nations: Be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah
text.WEB: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

text.KJV: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
text.ASV: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, And go round about the city.
text.WEB: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

text.KJV: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
text.ASV: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; Swords are in their lips: For who, `say they', doth hear?
text.WEB: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

text.KJV: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
text.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; Thou wilt have all the nations in derision.
text.WEB: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

text.KJV: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
text.ASV: `Because of' his strength I will give heed unto thee; For God is my high tower.
text.WEB: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

text.KJV: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
text.ASV: My God with his lovingkindness will meet me: God will let me see `my desire' upon mine enemies.
text.WEB: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

text.KJV: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
text.ASV: Slay them not, lest my people forget: Scatter them by thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
text.WEB: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

text.KJV: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
text.ASV: `For' the sin of their mouth, `and' the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for cursing and lying which they speak.
text.WEB: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

text.KJV: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
text.ASV: Consume them in wrath, consume them, so that they shall be no more: And let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, Unto the ends of the earth. Selah
text.WEB: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

text.KJV: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
text.ASV: And at evening let them return, let them howl like a dog, And go round about the city.
text.WEB: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

text.KJV: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
text.ASV: They shall wander up and down for food, And tarry all night if they be not satisfied.
text.WEB: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

text.KJV: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
text.ASV: But I will sing of thy strength; Yea, I will sing aloud of thy lovingkindness in the morning: For thou hast been my high tower, And a refuge in the day of my distress.
text.WEB: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

text.KJV: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
text.ASV: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing praises: For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy. Psalm 60 For the Chief Musician; `set to' Shushan Eduth. Michtam of David, to teach; and when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.
text.WEB: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

text.KJV: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
text.ASV: O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.
text.WEB: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

text.KJV: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
text.ASV: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it: Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
text.WEB: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

text.KJV: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
text.ASV: Thou hast showed thy people hard things: Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.
text.WEB: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

text.KJV: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
text.ASV: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah
text.WEB: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

text.KJV: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
text.ASV: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.
text.WEB: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

text.KJV: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
text.ASV: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
text.WEB: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

text.KJV: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
text.ASV: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
text.WEB: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

text.KJV: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
text.ASV: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe: Philistia, shout thou because of me.
text.WEB: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

text.KJV: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
text.ASV: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
text.WEB: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

text.KJV: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
text.ASV: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
text.WEB: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

text.KJV: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
text.ASV: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
text.WEB: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

text.KJV: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
text.ASV: Through God we shall do valiantly; For he it is that will tread down our adversaries. Psalm 61 For the Chief Musician; on a stringed instrument. `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

text.KJV: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
text.ASV: Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.
text.WEB: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

text.KJV: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
text.ASV: From the end of the earth will I call unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
text.WEB: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

text.KJV: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
text.ASV: For thou hast been a refuge for me, A strong tower from the enemy.
text.WEB: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

text.KJV: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
text.ASV: I will dwell in thy tabernacle for ever: I will take refuge in the covert of thy wings. Selah
text.WEB: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

text.KJV: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
text.ASV: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast given `me' the heritage of those that fear thy name.
text.WEB: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

text.KJV: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
text.ASV: Thou wilt prolong the king's life; His years shall be as many generations.
text.WEB: You will prolong the king’s life; his years shall be for generations.

text.KJV: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
text.ASV: He shall abide before God for ever: Oh prepare lovingkindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
text.WEB: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

text.KJV: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
text.ASV: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows. Psalm 62 For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthan. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

text.KJV: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
text.ASV: My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From him `cometh' my salvation.
text.WEB: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

text.KJV: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
text.ASV: He only is my rock and my salvation: `He is' my high tower; I shall not be greatly moved.
text.WEB: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress— I will never be greatly shaken.

text.KJV: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
text.ASV: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay `him', all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
text.WEB: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

text.KJV: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
text.ASV: They only consult to thrust him down from his dignity; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah
text.WEB: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

text.KJV: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
text.ASV: My soul, wait thou in silence for God only; For my expectation is from him.
text.WEB: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

text.KJV: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
text.ASV: He only is my rock and my salvation: `He is' my high tower; I shall not be moved.
text.WEB: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

text.KJV: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
text.ASV: With God is my salvation and my glory: The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
text.WEB: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

text.KJV: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
text.ASV: Trust in him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah
text.WEB: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

text.KJV: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
text.ASV: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: In the balances they will go up; They are together lighter than vanity.
text.WEB: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

text.KJV: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
text.ASV: Trust not in oppression, And become not vain in robbery: If riches increase, set not your heart `thereon'.
text.WEB: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

text.KJV: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
text.ASV: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this, That power belongeth unto God.
text.WEB: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

text.KJV: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
text.ASV: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth lovingkindness; For thou renderest to every man according to his work. Psalm 63 A Psalm of David when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
text.WEB: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

text.KJV: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
text.ASV: O God, thou art my God; earnestly will I seek thee: My soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
text.WEB: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

text.KJV: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
text.ASV: So have I looked upon thee in the sanctuary, To see thy power and thy glory.
text.WEB: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

text.KJV: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
text.ASV: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise thee.
text.WEB: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

text.KJV: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
text.ASV: So will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
text.WEB: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

text.KJV: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
text.ASV: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips;
text.WEB: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

text.KJV: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
text.ASV: When I remember thee upon my bed, `And' meditate on thee in the night-watches.
text.WEB: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

text.KJV: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
text.ASV: For thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
text.WEB: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

text.KJV: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
text.ASV: My soul followeth hard after thee: Thy right hand upholdeth me.
text.WEB: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

text.KJV: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
text.ASV: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
text.WEB: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

text.KJV: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
text.ASV: They shall be given over to the power of the sword: They shall be a portion for foxes.
text.WEB: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

text.KJV: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
text.ASV: But the king shall rejoice in God: Every one that sweareth by him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped. Psalm 64 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

text.KJV: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
text.ASV: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint: Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
text.WEB: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

text.KJV: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
text.ASV: Hide me from the secret counsel of evil-doers, From the tumult of the workers of iniquity;
text.WEB: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

text.KJV: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
text.ASV: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, And have aimed their arrows, even bitter words,
text.WEB: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

text.KJV: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
text.ASV: That they may shoot in secret places at the perfect: Suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
text.WEB: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

text.KJV: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
text.ASV: They encourage themselves in an evil purpose; They commune of laying snares privily; They say, Who will see them?
text.WEB: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

text.KJV: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
text.ASV: They search out iniquities; We have accomplished, `say they', a diligent search: And the inward thought and the heart of every one is deep.
text.WEB: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

text.KJV: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
text.ASV: But God will shoot at them; With an arrow suddenly shall they be wounded.
text.WEB: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

text.KJV: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
text.ASV: So they shall be made to stumble, their own tongue being against them: All that see them shall wag the head.
text.WEB: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

text.KJV: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
text.ASV: And all men shall fear; And they shall declare the work of God, And shall wisely consider of his doing.
text.WEB: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

text.KJV: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
text.ASV: The righteous shall be glad in Jehovah, and shall take refuge in him; And all the upright in heart shall glory. Psalm 65 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm. A song of David.
text.WEB: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

text.KJV: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
text.ASV: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion; And unto thee shall the vow be performed.
text.WEB: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. To you shall vows be performed.

text.KJV: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
text.ASV: O thou that hearest prayer, Unto thee shall all flesh come.
text.WEB: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

text.KJV: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
text.ASV: Iniquities prevail against me: As for our transgressions, thou wilt forgive them.
text.WEB: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

text.KJV: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
text.ASV: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach `unto thee', That he may dwell in thy courts: We shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, Thy holy temple.
text.WEB: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

text.KJV: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
text.ASV: By terrible things thou wilt answer us in righteousness, Oh God of our salvation, Thou that art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of them that are afar off upon the sea:
text.WEB: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea;

text.KJV: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
text.ASV: Who by his strength setteth fast the mountains, Being girded about with might;
text.WEB: Who by his power forms the mountains, having armed yourself with strength;

text.KJV: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
text.ASV: Who stilleth the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.
text.WEB: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

text.KJV: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
text.ASV: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
text.WEB: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

text.KJV: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
text.ASV: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it, Thou greatly enrichest it; The river of God is full of water: Thou providest them grain, when thou hast so prepared the earth.
text.WEB: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

text.KJV: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
text.ASV: Thou waterest its furrows abundantly; Thou settlest the ridges thereof: Thou makest it soft with showers; Thou blessest the springing thereof.
text.WEB: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

text.KJV: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
text.ASV: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; And thy paths drop fatness.
text.WEB: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

text.KJV: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
text.ASV: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness; And the hills are girded with joy.
text.WEB: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

text.KJV: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
text.ASV: The pastures are clothed with flocks; The valleys also are covered over with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing. Psalm 66 For the Chief Musician. A song, a Psalm.
text.WEB: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

text.KJV: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
text.ASV: Make a joyful noise unto God, all the earth:
text.WEB: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

text.KJV: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
text.ASV: Sing forth the glory of his name: Make his praise glorious.
text.WEB: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

text.KJV: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
text.ASV: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
text.WEB: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

text.KJV: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
text.ASV: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; They shall sing to thy name. Selah
text.WEB: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

text.KJV: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
text.ASV: Come, and see the works of God; `He is' terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
text.WEB: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

text.KJV: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
text.ASV: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot: There did we rejoice in him.
text.WEB: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

text.KJV: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
text.ASV: He ruleth by his might for ever; His eyes observe the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
text.WEB: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

text.KJV: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
text.ASV: Oh bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of his praise to be heard;
text.WEB: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

text.KJV: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
text.ASV: Who holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.
text.WEB: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

text.KJV: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
text.ASV: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
text.WEB: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

text.KJV: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
text.ASV: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou layedst a sore burden upon our loins.
text.WEB: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

text.KJV: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
text.ASV: Thou didst cause men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
text.WEB: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

text.KJV: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
text.ASV: I will come into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will pay thee my vows,
text.WEB: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

text.KJV: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
text.ASV: Which my lips uttered, And my mouth spake, when I was in distress.
text.WEB: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

text.KJV: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
text.ASV: I will offer unto thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah
text.WEB: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

text.KJV: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
text.ASV: Come, and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
text.WEB: Come, and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

text.KJV: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
text.ASV: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.
text.WEB: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

text.KJV: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
text.ASV: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear:
text.WEB: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

text.KJV: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
text.ASV: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
text.WEB: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

text.KJV: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
text.ASV: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his lovingkindness from me. Psalm 67 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm, a song.
text.WEB: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

text.KJV: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
text.ASV: God be merciful unto us, and bless us, `And' cause his face to shine upon us; Selah
text.WEB: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

text.KJV: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
text.ASV: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.
text.WEB: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

text.KJV: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
text.ASV: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.
text.WEB: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

text.KJV: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
text.ASV: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And govern the nations upon earth. Selah
text.WEB: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

text.KJV: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
text.ASV: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.
text.WEB: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

text.KJV: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
text.ASV: The earth hath yielded its increase: God, even our own God, will bless us.
text.WEB: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

text.KJV: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
text.ASV: God will bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him. Psalm 68 For the Chief Musician; A Psalm of David, a song.
text.WEB: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

text.KJV: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
text.ASV: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered; Let them also that hate him flee before him.
text.WEB: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

text.KJV: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
text.ASV: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
text.WEB: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

text.KJV: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
text.ASV: But let the righteous be glad; let them exult before God: Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.
text.WEB: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

text.KJV: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
text.ASV: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: Cast up a highway for him that rideth through the deserts; His name is Jehovah; and exult ye before him.
text.WEB: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

text.KJV: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
text.ASV: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in his holy habitation.
text.WEB: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

text.KJV: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
text.ASV: God setteth the solitary in families: He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a parched land.
text.WEB: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

text.KJV: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
text.ASV: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, When thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah
text.WEB: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

text.KJV: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
text.ASV: The earth trembled, The heavens also dropped `rain' at the presence of God: Yon Sinai `trembled' at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
text.WEB: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

text.KJV: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
text.ASV: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, Thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
text.WEB: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance, when it was weary.

text.KJV: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
text.ASV: Thy congregation dwelt therein: Thou, O God, didst prepare of thy goodness for the poor.
text.WEB: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

text.KJV: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
text.ASV: The Lord giveth the word: The women that publish the tidings are a great host.
text.WEB: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

text.KJV: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
text.ASV: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.
text.WEB: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

text.KJV: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
text.ASV: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, `It is as' the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her pinions with yellow gold.
text.WEB: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

text.KJV: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
text.ASV: When the Almighty scattered kings therein, `It was as when' it snoweth in Zalmon.
text.WEB: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

text.KJV: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
text.ASV: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A high mountain is the mountain of Bashan.
text.WEB: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

text.KJV: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
text.ASV: Why look ye askance, ye high mountains, At the mountain which God hath desired for his abode? Yea, Jehovah will dwell `in it' for ever.
text.WEB: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.

text.KJV: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
text.ASV: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands upon thousands; The Lord is among them, `as in' Sinai, in the sanctuary.
text.WEB: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

text.KJV: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
text.ASV: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led away captives; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, `among' the rebellious also, that Jehovah God might dwell `with them'.
text.WEB: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among men, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.

text.KJV: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
text.ASV: Blessed be the Lord, who daily beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. Selah
text.WEB: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

text.KJV: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
text.ASV: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto Jehovah the Lord belongeth escape from death.
text.WEB: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

text.KJV: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
text.ASV: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, The hairy scalp of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness.
text.WEB: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

text.KJV: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
text.ASV: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring `them' again from the depths of the sea;
text.WEB: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;

text.KJV: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
text.ASV: That thou mayest crush `them', `dipping' thy foot in blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from `thine' enemies.
text.WEB: That you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

text.KJV: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
text.ASV: They have seen thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
text.WEB: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

text.KJV: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
text.ASV: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, In the midst of the damsels playing with timbrels.
text.WEB: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

text.KJV: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
text.ASV: Bless ye God in the congregations, Even the Lord, `ye that are' of the fountain of Israel.
text.WEB: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

text.KJV: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
