text.ASV: There is little Benjamin their ruler, The princes of Judah `and' their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
text.WEB: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

text.KJV: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
text.ASV: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: Strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
text.WEB: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

text.KJV: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
text.ASV: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem Kings shall bring presents unto thee.
text.WEB: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

text.KJV: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
text.ASV: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Trampling under foot the pieces of silver: He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war.
text.WEB: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.

text.KJV: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
text.ASV: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall haste to stretch out her hands unto God.
text.WEB: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

text.KJV: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
text.ASV: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; Oh sing praises unto the Lord; Selah
text.WEB: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! Selah.

text.KJV: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
text.ASV: To him that rideth upon the heaven of heavens, which are of old; Lo, he uttereth his voice, a mighty voice.
text.WEB: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

text.KJV: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
text.ASV: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the skies.
text.WEB: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

text.KJV: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
text.ASV: O God, `thou art' terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel, he giveth strength and power unto `his' people. Blessed be God. Psalm 69 For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshanim. `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

text.KJV: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
text.ASV: Save me, O God; For the waters are come in unto my soul.
text.WEB: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

text.KJV: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
text.ASV: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
text.WEB: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

text.KJV: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
text.ASV: I am weary with my crying; my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
text.WEB: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

text.KJV: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
text.ASV: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: That which I took not away I have to restore.
text.WEB: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

text.KJV: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
text.ASV: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.
text.WEB: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

text.KJV: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
text.ASV: Let not them that wait for thee be put to shame through me, O Lord Jehovah of hosts: Let not those that seek thee be brought to dishonor through me, O God of Israel.
text.WEB: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

text.KJV: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
text.ASV: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.
text.WEB: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

text.KJV: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
text.ASV: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children.
text.WEB: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

text.KJV: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
text.ASV: For the zeal of thy house hath eaten me up; And the reproaches of them that reproach thee are fallen upon me.
text.WEB: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

text.KJV: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
text.ASV: When I wept, `and chastened' my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.
text.WEB: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

text.KJV: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
text.ASV: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword unto them.
text.WEB: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

text.KJV: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
text.ASV: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And `I am' the song of the drunkards.
text.WEB: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

text.KJV: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
text.ASV: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Jehovah, in an acceptable time: O God, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness, Answer me in the truth of thy salvation.
text.WEB: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

text.KJV: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
text.ASV: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
text.WEB: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

text.KJV: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
text.ASV: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep shallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth upon me.
text.WEB: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

text.KJV: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
text.ASV: Answer me, O Jehovah; for thy lovingkindness is good: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies turn thou unto me.
text.WEB: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

text.KJV: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
text.ASV: And hide not thy face from thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.
text.WEB: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

text.KJV: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
text.ASV: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: Ransom me because of mine enemies.
text.WEB: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

text.KJV: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
text.ASV: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor: Mine adversaries are all before thee.
text.WEB: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

text.KJV: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
text.ASV: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.
text.WEB: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

text.KJV: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
text.ASV: They gave me also gall for my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
text.WEB: They also gave me gall for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

text.KJV: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
text.ASV: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, `let it become' a trap.
text.WEB: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

text.KJV: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
text.ASV: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see; And make their loins continually to shake.
text.WEB: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

text.KJV: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
text.ASV: Pour out thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of thine anger overtake them.
text.WEB: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

text.KJV: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
text.ASV: Let their habitation be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.
text.WEB: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

text.KJV: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
text.ASV: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; And they tell of the sorrow of those whom thou hast wounded.
text.WEB: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

text.KJV: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
text.ASV: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into thy righteousness.
text.WEB: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

text.KJV: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
text.ASV: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, And not be written with the righteous.
text.WEB: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

text.KJV: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
text.ASV: But I am poor and sorrowful: Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
text.WEB: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

text.KJV: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
text.ASV: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify him with thanksgiving.
text.WEB: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

text.KJV: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
text.ASV: And it will please Jehovah better than an ox, `Or' a bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
text.WEB: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

text.KJV: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
text.ASV: The meek have seen it, and are glad: Ye that seek after God, let your heart live.
text.WEB: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

text.KJV: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
text.ASV: For Jehovah heareth the needy, And despiseth not his prisoners.
text.WEB: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

text.KJV: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
text.ASV: Let heaven and earth praise him, The seas, and everything that moveth therein.
text.WEB: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

text.KJV: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
text.ASV: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.
text.WEB: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

text.KJV: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
text.ASV: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it; And they that love his name shall dwell therein. Psalm 70 For the Chief Musician. `A Psalm' of David; to bring to remembrance.
text.WEB: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

text.KJV: MAKE HASTE, O GOD, TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O LORD.
text.ASV: `Make haste', O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
text.ASV: Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.
text.WEB: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

text.KJV: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
text.ASV: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say, Aha, aha.
text.WEB: Let them be turned because of their shame Who say, “Aha! Aha!”

text.KJV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
text.ASV: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
text.WEB: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

text.KJV: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
text.ASV: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.
text.WEB: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.

text.KJV: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
text.ASV: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge: Let me never be put to shame.
text.WEB: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

text.KJV: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
text.ASV: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and rescue me: Bow down thine ear unto me, and save me.
text.WEB: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

text.KJV: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
text.ASV: Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.
text.WEB: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

text.KJV: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
text.ASV: Rescue me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
text.WEB: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

text.KJV: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
text.ASV: For thou art my hope, O Lord Jehovah: `Thou art' my trust from my youth.
text.WEB: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh; my confidence from my youth.

text.KJV: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
text.ASV: By thee have I been holden up from the womb; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.
text.WEB: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

text.KJV: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
text.ASV: I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.
text.WEB: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

text.KJV: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
text.ASV: My mouth shall be filled with thy praise, And with thy honor all the day.
text.WEB: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

text.KJV: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
text.ASV: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.
text.WEB: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

text.KJV: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
text.ASV: For mine enemies speak concerning me; And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,
text.WEB: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

text.KJV: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
text.ASV: Saying, God hath forsaken him: Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.
text.WEB: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

text.KJV: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
text.ASV: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.
text.WEB: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

text.KJV: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
text.ASV: Let them be put to shame `and' consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor that seek my hurt.
text.WEB: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

text.KJV: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
text.ASV: But I will hope continually, And will praise thee yet more and more.
text.WEB: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

text.KJV: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
text.ASV: My mouth shall tell of thy righteousness, `And' of thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers `thereof'.
text.WEB: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

text.KJV: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
text.ASV: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Jehovah: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
text.WEB: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

text.KJV: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
text.ASV: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth; And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
text.WEB: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

text.KJV: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
text.ASV: Yea, even when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not, Until I have declared thy strength unto `the next' generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.
text.WEB: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

text.KJV: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
text.ASV: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto thee?
text.WEB: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?

text.KJV: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
text.ASV: Thou, who hast showed us many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken us again, And wilt bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
text.WEB: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

text.KJV: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
text.ASV: Increase thou my greatness, And turn again and comfort me.
text.WEB: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.

text.KJV: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
text.ASV: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, `Even' thy truth, O my God: Unto thee will I sing praises with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
text.WEB: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

text.KJV: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
text.ASV: My lips shall shout for joy when I sing praises unto thee; And my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
text.WEB: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

text.KJV: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
text.ASV: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long; For they are put to shame, for they are confounded, that seek my hurt. Psalm 72 `A Psalm' of Solomon.
text.WEB: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

text.KJV: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
text.ASV: Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king's son.
text.WEB: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

text.KJV: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
text.ASV: He will judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with justice.
text.WEB: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

text.KJV: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
text.ASV: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.
text.WEB: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

text.KJV: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
text.ASV: He will judge the poor of the people, He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.
text.WEB: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

text.KJV: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
text.ASV: They shall fear thee while the sun endureth, And so long as the moon, throughout all generations.
text.WEB: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

text.KJV: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
text.ASV: He will come down like rain upon the mown grass, As showers that water the earth.
text.WEB: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

text.KJV: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
text.ASV: In his days shall the righteous flourish, And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.
text.WEB: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

text.KJV: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
text.ASV: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth.
text.WEB: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

text.KJV: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
text.ASV: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.
text.WEB: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

text.KJV: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
text.ASV: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
text.WEB: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

text.KJV: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
text.ASV: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him; All nations shall serve him.
text.WEB: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

text.KJV: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
text.ASV: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth, And the poor, that hath no helper.
text.WEB: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

text.KJV: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
text.ASV: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.
text.WEB: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

text.KJV: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
text.ASV: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence; And precious will their blood be in his sight:
text.WEB: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

text.KJV: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
text.ASV: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: And men shall pray for him continually; They shall bless him all the day long.
text.WEB: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.

text.KJV: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
text.ASV: There shall be abundance of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
text.WEB: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

text.KJV: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
text.ASV: His name shall endure for ever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him; All nations shall call him happy.
text.WEB: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things:
text.WEB: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

text.KJV: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
text.ASV: And blessed be his glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen, and Amen.
text.WEB: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

text.KJV: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
text.ASV: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended. Psalm 73 A Psalm of Asaph.
text.WEB: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

text.KJV: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
text.ASV: Surely God is good to Israel, `Even' to such as are pure in heart.
text.WEB: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

text.KJV: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
text.ASV: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.
text.WEB: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

text.KJV: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
text.ASV: For I was envious at the arrogant, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
text.WEB: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

text.KJV: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
text.ASV: For there are no pangs in their death; But their strength is firm.
text.WEB: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

text.KJV: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
text.ASV: They are not in trouble as `other' men; Neither are they plagued like `other' men.
text.WEB: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

text.KJV: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
text.ASV: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; Violence covereth them as a garment.
text.WEB: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

text.KJV: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
text.ASV: Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.
text.WEB: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

text.KJV: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
text.ASV: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression: They speak loftily.
text.WEB: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

text.KJV: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
text.ASV: They have set their mouth in the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.
text.WEB: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

text.KJV: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
text.ASV: Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a full `cup' are drained by them.
text.WEB: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

text.KJV: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
text.ASV: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?
text.WEB: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

text.KJV: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
text.ASV: Behold, these are the wicked; And, being alway at ease, they increase in riches.
text.WEB: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

text.KJV: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
text.ASV: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;
text.WEB: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

text.KJV: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
text.ASV: For all the day long have I been plagued, And chastened every morning.
text.WEB: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

text.KJV: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
text.ASV: If I had said, I will speak thus; Behold, I had dealt treacherously with the generation of thy children.
text.WEB: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

text.KJV: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
text.ASV: When I thought how I might know this, It was too painful for me;
text.WEB: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;

text.KJV: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
text.ASV: Until I went into the sanctuary of God, And considered their latter end.
text.WEB: Until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

text.KJV: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
text.ASV: Surely thou settest them in slippery places: Thou castest them down to destruction.
text.WEB: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

text.KJV: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
text.ASV: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.
text.WEB: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

text.KJV: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
text.ASV: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou wilt despise their image.
text.WEB: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

text.KJV: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
text.ASV: For my soul was grieved, And I was pricked in my heart:
text.WEB: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

text.KJV: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
text.ASV: So brutish was I, and ignorant; I was `as' a beast before thee.
text.WEB: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

text.KJV: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
text.ASV: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden my right hand.
text.WEB: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

text.KJV: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
text.ASV: Thou wilt guide me with thy counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.
text.WEB: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

text.KJV: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
text.ASV: Whom have I in heaven `but thee'? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides thee.
text.WEB: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

text.KJV: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
text.ASV: My flesh and my heart faileth; `But' God is the strength of my heart and my portion for ever.
text.WEB: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

text.KJV: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
text.ASV: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that play the harlot, `departing' from thee.
text.WEB: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

text.KJV: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
text.ASV: But it is good for me to draw near unto God: I have made the Lord Jehovah my refuge, That I may tell of all thy works. Psalm 74 Maschil of Asaph.
text.WEB: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

text.KJV: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
text.ASV: O God, why hast thou cast `us' off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
text.WEB: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

text.KJV: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
text.ASV: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast gotten of old, Which thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of thine inheritance; `And' mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
text.WEB: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

text.KJV: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
text.ASV: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual ruins, All the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.
text.WEB: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

text.KJV: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
text.ASV: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of thine assembly; They have set up their ensigns for signs.
text.WEB: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

text.KJV: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
text.ASV: They seemed as men that lifted up Axes upon a thicket of trees.
text.WEB: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

text.KJV: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
text.ASV: And now all the carved work thereof They break down with hatchet and hammers.
text.WEB: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

text.KJV: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
text.ASV: They have set thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of thy name `by casting it' to the ground.
text.WEB: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

text.KJV: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
text.ASV: They said in their heart, Let us make havoc of them altogether: They have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
text.WEB: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

text.KJV: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
text.ASV: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
text.WEB: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

text.KJV: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
text.ASV: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
text.WEB: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

text.KJV: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
text.ASV: Why drawest thou back thy hand, even thy right hand? `Pluck it' out of thy bosom `and' consume `them'.
text.WEB: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

text.KJV: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
text.ASV: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.
text.WEB: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

text.KJV: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
text.ASV: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.
text.WEB: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

text.KJV: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
text.ASV: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces; Thou gavest him to be food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
text.WEB: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

text.KJV: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
text.ASV: Thou didst cleave fountain and flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.
text.WEB: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

text.KJV: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
text.ASV: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
text.WEB: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

text.KJV: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
text.ASV: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.
text.WEB: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

text.KJV: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
text.ASV: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Jehovah, And that a foolish people hath blasphemed thy name.
text.WEB: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

text.KJV: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
text.ASV: Oh deliver not the soul of thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast: Forget not the life of thy poor for ever.
text.WEB: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

text.KJV: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
text.ASV: Have respect unto the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of violence.
text.WEB: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

text.KJV: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
text.ASV: Oh let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.
text.WEB: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

text.KJV: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
text.ASV: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee all the day.
text.WEB: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

text.KJV: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
text.ASV: Forget not the voice of thine adversaries: The tumult of those that rise up against thee ascendeth continually. Psalm 75 For the Chief Musician; `set to' Al-tash-heth. A Psalm of Asaph; a song.
text.WEB: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

text.KJV: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
text.ASV: We give thanks unto thee, O God; We give thanks, for thy name is near: Men tell of thy wondrous works.
text.WEB: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

text.KJV: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
text.ASV: When I shall find the set time, I will judge uprightly.
text.WEB: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

text.KJV: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
text.ASV: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have set up the pillars of it. Selah
text.WEB: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

text.KJV: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
text.ASV: I said unto the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly; And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
text.WEB: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

text.KJV: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
text.ASV: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not with a stiff neck.
text.WEB: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

text.KJV: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
text.ASV: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the south, `cometh' lifting up.
text.WEB: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

text.KJV: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
text.ASV: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.
text.WEB: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

text.KJV: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
text.ASV: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.
text.WEB: For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

text.KJV: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
text.ASV: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
text.WEB: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

text.KJV: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
text.ASV: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up. Psalm 76 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a song.
text.WEB: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

text.KJV: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
text.ASV: In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.
text.WEB: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

text.KJV: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
text.ASV: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling-place in Zion.
text.WEB: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.

text.KJV: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
text.ASV: There he brake the arrows of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah
text.WEB: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

text.KJV: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
text.ASV: Glorious art thou `and' excellent, From the mountains of prey.
text.WEB: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

text.KJV: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
text.ASV: The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.
text.WEB: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

text.KJV: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
text.ASV: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.
text.WEB: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

text.KJV: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
text.ASV: Thou, even thou, art to be feared; And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
text.WEB: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

text.KJV: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
text.ASV: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
text.WEB: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

text.KJV: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
text.ASV: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. Selah
text.WEB: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

text.KJV: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
text.ASV: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The residue of wrath shalt thou gird upon thee.
text.WEB: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

text.KJV: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
text.ASV: Vow, and pay unto Jehovah your God: Let all that are round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
text.WEB: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

text.KJV: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
text.ASV: He will cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth. Psalm 77 For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthan. A Psalm of Asaph.
text.WEB: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

text.KJV: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
text.ASV: I will cry unto God with my voice, Even unto God with my voice; and he will give ear unto me.
text.WEB: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

text.KJV: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
text.ASV: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: My hand was stretched out in the night, and slacked not; My soul refused to be comforted.
text.WEB: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

text.KJV: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
text.ASV: I remember God, and am disquieted: I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah
text.WEB: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

text.KJV: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
text.ASV: Thou holdest mine eyes watching: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
text.WEB: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

text.KJV: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
text.ASV: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.
text.WEB: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

text.KJV: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
text.ASV: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search.
text.WEB: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

text.KJV: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
text.ASV: Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will he be favorable no more?
text.WEB: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

text.KJV: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
text.ASV: Is his lovingkindness clean gone for ever? Doth his promise fail for evermore?
text.WEB: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

text.KJV: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
text.ASV: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah
text.WEB: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

text.KJV: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
text.ASV: And I said, This is my infirmity; `But I will remember' the years of the right hand of the Most High.
text.WEB: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

text.KJV: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
text.ASV: I will make mention of the deeds of Jehovah; For I will remember thy wonders of old.
text.WEB: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

text.KJV: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
text.ASV: I will meditate also upon all thy work, And muse on thy doings.
text.WEB: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

text.KJV: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
text.ASV: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: Who is a great god like unto God?
text.WEB: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

text.KJV: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
text.ASV: Thou art the God that doest wonders: Thou hast made known thy strength among the peoples.
text.WEB: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

text.KJV: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
text.ASV: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
text.WEB: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

text.KJV: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
text.ASV: The waters saw thee, O God; The waters saw thee, they were afraid: The depths also trembled.
text.WEB: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

text.KJV: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
text.ASV: The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.
text.WEB: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

text.KJV: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
text.ASV: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.
text.WEB: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

text.KJV: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
text.ASV: Thy way was in the sea, And thy paths in the great waters, And thy footsteps were not known.
text.WEB: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

text.KJV: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
text.ASV: Thou leddest thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron. Psalm 78 Maschil of Asaph.
text.WEB: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

text.KJV: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
text.ASV: Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
text.WEB: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

text.KJV: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
text.ASV: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,
text.WEB: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

text.KJV: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
text.ASV: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.
text.WEB: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

text.KJV: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
text.ASV: We will not hide them from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of Jehovah, And his strength, and his wondrous works that he hath done.
text.WEB: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

text.KJV: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
text.ASV: For he established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;
text.WEB: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

text.KJV: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
text.ASV: That the generation to come might know `them', even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell `them' to their children,
text.WEB: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

text.KJV: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
text.ASV: That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep his commandments,
text.WEB: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

text.KJV: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
text.ASV: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
text.WEB: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

text.KJV: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
text.ASV: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.
text.WEB: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

text.KJV: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
text.ASV: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;
text.WEB: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

text.KJV: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
text.ASV: And they forgat his doings, And his wondrous works that he had showed them.
text.WEB: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

text.KJV: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
text.ASV: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
text.WEB: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

text.KJV: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
text.ASV: He clave the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as a heap.
text.WEB: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

text.KJV: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
text.ASV: In the day-time also he led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.
text.WEB: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

text.KJV: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
text.ASV: He clave rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
text.WEB: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

text.KJV: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
text.ASV: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.
text.WEB: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

text.KJV: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
text.ASV: Yet went they on still to sin against him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.
text.WEB: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

text.KJV: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
text.ASV: And they tempted God in their heart By asking food according to their desire.
text.WEB: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

text.KJV: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
text.ASV: Yea, they spake against God; They said, Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
text.WEB: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

text.KJV: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
text.ASV: Behold, he smote the rock, so that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?
text.WEB: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

text.KJV: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
text.ASV: Therefore Jehovah heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;
text.WEB: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

text.KJV: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
text.ASV: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in his salvation.
text.WEB: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

text.KJV: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
text.ASV: Yet he commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;
text.WEB: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

text.KJV: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
text.ASV: And he rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them food from heaven.
text.WEB: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

text.KJV: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
text.ASV: Man did eat the bread of the mighty: He sent them food to the full.
text.WEB: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

text.KJV: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
text.ASV: He caused the east wind to blow in the heavens; And by his power he guided the south wind.
text.WEB: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

text.KJV: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
text.ASV: He rained flesh also upon them as the dust, And winged birds as the sand of the seas:
text.WEB: He rained also meat on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.

text.KJV: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
text.ASV: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their habitations.
text.WEB: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

text.KJV: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
text.ASV: So they did eat, and were well filled; And he gave them their own desire.
text.WEB: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

text.KJV: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
text.ASV: They were not estranged from that which they desired, Their food was yet in their mouths,
text.WEB: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

text.KJV: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
text.ASV: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the fattest of them, And smote down the young men of Israel.
text.WEB: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

text.KJV: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
text.ASV: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in his wondrous works.
text.WEB: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

text.KJV: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
text.ASV: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in terror.
text.WEB: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

text.KJV: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
text.ASV: When he slew them, then they inquired after him; And they returned and sought God earnestly.
text.WEB: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

text.KJV: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
text.ASV: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.
text.WEB: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

text.KJV: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
text.ASV: But they flattered him with their mouth, And lied unto him with their tongue.
text.WEB: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

text.KJV: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
text.ASV: For their heart was not right with him, Neither were they faithful in his covenant.
text.WEB: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

text.KJV: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
text.ASV: But he, being merciful, forgave `their' iniquity, and destroyed `them' not: Yea, many a time turned he his anger away, And did not stir up all his wrath.
text.WEB: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

text.KJV: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
text.ASV: And he remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
text.WEB: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

text.KJV: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
text.ASV: How oft did they rebel against him in the wilderness, And grieve him in the desert!
text.WEB: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

text.KJV: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
text.ASV: And they turned again and tempted God, And provoked the Holy One of Israel.
text.WEB: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

text.KJV: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
text.ASV: They remember not his hand, Nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
text.WEB: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

text.KJV: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan.
text.ASV: How he set his signs in Egypt, And his wonders in the field of Zoan,
text.WEB: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

text.KJV: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
text.ASV: And turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, so that they could not drink.
text.WEB: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

text.KJV: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
text.ASV: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.
text.WEB: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

text.KJV: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
text.ASV: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labor unto the locust.
text.WEB: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

text.KJV: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
text.ASV: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore-trees with frost.
text.WEB: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

text.KJV: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
text.ASV: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
text.WEB: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

text.KJV: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
text.ASV: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A band of angels of evil.
text.WEB: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

text.KJV: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
text.ASV: He made a path for his anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence,
text.WEB: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

text.KJV: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
text.ASV: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
text.WEB: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

text.KJV: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
text.ASV: But he led forth his own people like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
text.WEB: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

text.KJV: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
text.ASV: And he led them safely, so that they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
text.WEB: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

text.KJV: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
text.ASV: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, To this mountain, which his right hand had gotten.
text.WEB: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

text.KJV: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
text.ASV: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
text.WEB: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

text.KJV: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
text.ASV: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, And kept not his testimonies;
text.WEB: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies;

text.KJV: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
text.ASV: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers: They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
text.WEB: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

text.KJV: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
text.ASV: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, And moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
text.WEB: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

text.KJV: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
text.ASV: When God heard `this', he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel;
text.WEB: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;

text.KJV: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
text.ASV: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which he placed among men;
text.WEB: So that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

text.KJV: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
text.ASV: And delivered his strength into captivity, And his glory into the adversary's hand.
text.WEB: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

text.KJV: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
text.ASV: He gave his people over also unto the sword, And was wroth with his inheritance.
text.WEB: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

text.KJV: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
text.ASV: Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.
text.WEB: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

text.KJV: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
text.ASV: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation.
text.WEB: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

text.KJV: Then the LORD awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
text.ASV: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, Like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
text.WEB: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

text.KJV: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
text.ASV: And he smote his adversaries backward: He put them to a perpetual reproach.
text.WEB: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

text.KJV: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
text.ASV: Moreover he refused the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim,
text.WEB: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

text.KJV: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
text.ASV: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which he loved.
text.WEB: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

text.KJV: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
text.ASV: And he built his sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which he hath established for ever.
text.WEB: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

text.KJV: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
text.ASV: He chose David also his servant, And took him from the sheepfolds:
text.WEB: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

text.KJV: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
text.ASV: From following the ewes that have their young he brought him, To be the shepherd of Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
text.WEB: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

text.KJV: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
text.ASV: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands. Psalm 79 A Psalm of Asaph.
text.WEB: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

text.KJV: O god, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
text.ASV: O God, the nations are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
