text.WEB: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

text.KJV: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
text.ASV: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be food unto the birds of the heavens, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
text.WEB: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

text.KJV: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
text.ASV: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; And there was none to bury them.
text.WEB: Their blood they have shed like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

text.KJV: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
text.ASV: We are become a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and derision to them that are round about us.
text.WEB: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

text.KJV: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
text.ASV: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
text.WEB: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

text.KJV: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
text.ASV: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon thy name.
text.WEB: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you; on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name;

text.KJV: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
text.ASV: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.
text.WEB: For they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

text.KJV: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
text.ASV: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers: Let thy tender mercies speedily meet us; For we are brought very low.
text.WEB: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

text.KJV: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
text.ASV: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for thy name's sake.
text.WEB: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

text.KJV: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
text.ASV: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is their God? Let the avenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed Be known among the nations in our sight.
text.WEB: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

text.KJV: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
text.ASV: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee: According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to death;
text.WEB: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

text.KJV: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
text.ASV: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
text.WEB: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

text.KJV: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
text.ASV: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture Will give thee thanks for ever: We will show forth thy praise to all generations. Psalm 80 For the Chief Musician, set to Shoshanim Eduth.. A Psalm of Asaph.
text.WEB: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

text.KJV: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
text.ASV: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that sittest `above' the cherubim, shine forth.
text.WEB: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

text.KJV: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
text.ASV: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might, And come to save us.
text.WEB: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

text.KJV: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
text.ASV: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
text.WEB: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

text.KJV: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
text.ASV: O Jehovah God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
text.WEB: Yahweh God of Armies, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

text.KJV: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
text.ASV: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.
text.WEB: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

text.KJV: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
text.ASV: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors; And our enemies laugh among themselves.
text.WEB: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

text.KJV: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
text.ASV: Turn us again, O God of hosts; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
text.WEB: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

text.KJV: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
text.ASV: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.
text.WEB: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

text.KJV: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
text.ASV: Thou preparedst `room' before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.
text.WEB: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

text.KJV: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
text.ASV: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were `like' cedars of God.
text.WEB: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

text.KJV: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
text.ASV: It sent out its branches unto the sea, And its shoots unto the River.
text.WEB: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.

text.KJV: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
text.ASV: Why hast thou broken down its walls, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?
text.WEB: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

text.KJV: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
text.ASV: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.
text.WEB: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

text.KJV: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
text.ASV: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,
text.WEB: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

text.KJV: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
text.ASV: And the stock which thy right hand planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
text.WEB: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

text.KJV: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
text.ASV: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
text.WEB: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

text.KJV: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
text.ASV: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
text.WEB: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

text.KJV: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
text.ASV: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.
text.WEB: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

text.KJV: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
text.ASV: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved. Psalm 81 For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. `A Psalm' of Asaph.
text.WEB: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

text.KJV: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
text.ASV: Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
text.WEB: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

text.KJV: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
text.ASV: Raise a song, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.
text.WEB: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

text.KJV: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
text.ASV: Blow the trumpet at the new moon, At the full moon, on our feast-day.
text.WEB: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

text.KJV: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
text.ASV: For it is a statute for Israel, An ordinance of the God of Jacob.
text.WEB: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

text.KJV: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
text.ASV: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out over the land of Egypt, `Where' I heard a language that I knew not.
text.WEB: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

text.KJV: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
text.ASV: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were freed from the basket.
text.WEB: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

text.KJV: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
text.ASV: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah
text.WEB: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

text.KJV: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
text.ASV: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto me!
text.WEB: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

text.KJV: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
text.ASV: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.
text.WEB: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

text.KJV: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
text.ASV: I am Jehovah thy God, Who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
text.WEB: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

text.KJV: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
text.ASV: But my people hearkened not to my voice; And Israel would none of me.
text.WEB: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

text.KJV: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
text.ASV: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.
text.WEB: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

text.KJV: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
text.ASV: Oh that my people would hearken unto me, That Israel would walk in my ways!
text.WEB: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

text.KJV: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
text.ASV: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn my hand against their adversaries.
text.WEB: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

text.KJV: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
text.ASV: The haters of Jehovah should submit themselves unto him: But their time should endure for ever.
text.WEB: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

text.KJV: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
text.ASV: He would feed them also with the finest of the wheat; And with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee. Psalm 82 A Psalm of Asaph.
text.WEB: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

text.KJV: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
text.ASV: God standeth in the congregation of God; He judgeth among the gods.
text.WEB: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

text.KJV: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
text.ASV: How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? Selah
text.WEB: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

text.KJV: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
text.ASV: Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
text.WEB: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

text.KJV: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
text.ASV: Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
text.WEB: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

text.KJV: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
text.ASV: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
text.WEB: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

text.KJV: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
text.ASV: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.
text.WEB: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

text.KJV: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
text.ASV: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.
text.WEB: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

text.KJV: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
text.ASV: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations. Psalm 83 A song. A Psalm of Asaph.
text.WEB: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

text.KJV: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
text.ASV: O God, keep not thou silence: Hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
text.WEB: God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

text.KJV: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
text.ASV: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult; And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
text.WEB: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

text.KJV: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
text.ASV: Thy take crafty counsel against thy people, And consult together against thy hidden ones.
text.WEB: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

text.KJV: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
text.ASV: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
text.WEB: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

text.KJV: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
text.ASV: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against thee do they make a covenant:
text.WEB: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

text.KJV: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
text.ASV: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagarenes;
text.WEB: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

text.KJV: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
text.ASV: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre:
text.WEB: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

text.KJV: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
text.ASV: Assyria also is joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot. Selah
text.WEB: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

text.KJV: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
text.ASV: Do thou unto them as unto Midian, As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;
text.WEB: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

text.KJV: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
text.ASV: Who perished at Endor, Who became as dung for the earth.
text.WEB: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

text.KJV: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
text.ASV: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; Yea, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;
text.WEB: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

text.KJV: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
text.ASV: Who said, Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.
text.WEB: who said, “Let us take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

text.KJV: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
text.ASV: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.
text.WEB: My God, make them like tumbleweed; like chaff before the wind.

text.KJV: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
text.ASV: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains on fire,
text.WEB: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

text.KJV: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
text.ASV: So pursue them with thy tempest, And terrify them with thy storm.
text.WEB: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

text.KJV: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
text.ASV: Fill their faces with confusion, That they may seek thy name, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
text.ASV: Let them be put to shame and dismayed for ever; Yea, let them be confounded and perish;
text.WEB: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

text.KJV: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
text.ASV: That they may know that thou alone, whose name is Jehovah, Art the Most High over all the earth. Psalm 84 For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
text.WEB: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.

text.KJV: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
text.ASV: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!
text.WEB: How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

text.KJV: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
text.ASV: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh cry out unto the living God.
text.WEB: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

text.KJV: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
text.ASV: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, My King, and my God.
text.WEB: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

text.KJV: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
text.ASV: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. Selah
text.WEB: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

text.KJV: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
text.ASV: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the highways `to Zion'.
text.WEB: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

text.KJV: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
text.ASV: Passing through the valley of Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.
text.WEB: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

text.KJV: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
text.ASV: They go from strength to strength; Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.
text.WEB: They go from strength to strength. Everyone of them appears before God in Zion.

text.KJV: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
text.ASV: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
text.WEB: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

text.KJV: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
text.ASV: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.
text.WEB: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

text.KJV: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
text.ASV: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
text.WEB: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

text.KJV: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
text.ASV: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
text.WEB: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

text.KJV: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
text.ASV: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee. Psalm 85 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
text.WEB: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

text.KJV: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
text.ASV: Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land; Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
text.WEB: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

text.KJV: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
text.ASV: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; Thou hast covered all their sin. Selah
text.WEB: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

text.KJV: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
text.ASV: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; Thou hast turned `thyself' from the fierceness of thine anger.
text.WEB: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

text.KJV: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
text.ASV: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.
text.WEB: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

text.KJV: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
text.ASV: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
text.WEB: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

text.KJV: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
text.ASV: Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?
text.WEB: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

text.KJV: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
text.ASV: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.
text.WEB: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.

text.KJV: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
text.ASV: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.
text.WEB: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

text.KJV: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
text.ASV: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.
text.WEB: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

text.KJV: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
text.ASV: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
text.WEB: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

text.KJV: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
text.ASV: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.
text.WEB: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

text.KJV: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
text.ASV: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.
text.WEB: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

text.KJV: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
text.ASV: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall make his footsteps a way `to walk in'.
text.WEB: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.

text.KJV: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
text.ASV: Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
text.WEB: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

text.KJV: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
text.ASV: Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
text.WEB: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

text.KJV: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
text.ASV: Be merciful unto me, O Lord; For unto thee do I cry all the day long.
text.WEB: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

text.KJV: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
text.ASV: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
text.WEB: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

text.KJV: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
text.ASV: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.
text.WEB: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

text.KJV: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
text.ASV: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.
text.WEB: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

text.KJV: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
text.ASV: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee; For thou wilt answer me.
text.WEB: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

text.KJV: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
text.ASV: There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neither `are there any works' like unto thy works.
text.WEB: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

text.KJV: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
text.ASV: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify thy name.
text.WEB: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

text.KJV: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
text.ASV: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.
text.WEB: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

text.KJV: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
text.ASV: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.
text.WEB: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

text.KJV: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
text.ASV: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify thy name for evermore.
text.WEB: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

text.KJV: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
text.ASV: For great is thy lovingkindness toward me; And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
text.WEB: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

text.KJV: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
text.ASV: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And a company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set thee before them.
text.WEB: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

text.KJV: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
text.ASV: But thou, O Lord, art a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.
text.WEB: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

text.KJV: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
text.ASV: Oh turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thy handmaid.
text.WEB: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

text.KJV: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
text.ASV: Show me a token for good, That they who hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because thou, Jehovah, hast helped me, and comforted me. Psalm 87 A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song.
text.WEB: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.

text.KJV: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
text.ASV: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
text.WEB: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

text.KJV: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
text.ASV: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.
text.WEB: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

text.KJV: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
text.ASV: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah
text.WEB: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

text.KJV: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
text.ASV: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia: This one was born there.
text.WEB: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

text.KJV: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
text.ASV: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.
text.WEB: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her”; the Most High himself will establish her.

text.KJV: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
text.ASV: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. Selah
text.WEB: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

text.KJV: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
text.ASV: They that sing as well as they that dance `shall say', All my fountains are in thee. Psalm 88 A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Chief Musician; set to Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
text.WEB: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

text.KJV: O lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
text.ASV: O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee.
text.WEB: Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

text.KJV: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
text.ASV: Let my prayer enter into thy presence; Incline thine ear unto my cry.
text.WEB: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

text.KJV: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
text.ASV: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.
text.WEB: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

text.KJV: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
text.ASV: I am reckoned with them that go down into the pit; I am as a man that hath no help,
text.WEB: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

text.KJV: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
text.ASV: Cast off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.
text.WEB: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

text.KJV: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
text.ASV: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.
text.WEB: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

text.KJV: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
text.ASV: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah
text.WEB: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

text.KJV: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
text.ASV: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
text.WEB: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

text.KJV: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
text.ASV: Mine eye wasteth away by reason of affliction: I have called daily upon thee, O Jehovah; I have spread forth my hands unto thee.
text.WEB: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.

text.KJV: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
text.ASV: Wilt thou show wonders to the dead? Shall they that are decreased arise and praise thee? Selah
text.WEB: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

text.KJV: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
text.ASV: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or thy faithfulness in Destruction?
text.WEB: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

text.KJV: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
text.ASV: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? And thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
text.WEB: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

text.KJV: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
text.ASV: But unto thee, O Jehovah, have I cried; And in the morning shall my prayer come before thee.
text.WEB: But to you, Yahweh, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

text.KJV: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
text.ASV: Jehovah, why castest thou off my soul? Why hidest thou thy face from me?
text.WEB: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

text.KJV: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
text.ASV: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: While I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
text.WEB: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

text.KJV: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
text.ASV: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.
text.WEB: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

text.KJV: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
text.ASV: They came round about me like water all the day long; They compassed me about together.
text.WEB: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

text.KJV: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
text.ASV: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness. Psalm 89 Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.
text.WEB: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

text.KJV: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
text.ASV: I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
text.WEB: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

text.KJV: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
text.ASV: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.
text.WEB: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

text.KJV: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
text.ASV: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant:
text.WEB: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

text.KJV: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
text.ASV: Thy seed will I establish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. Selah
text.WEB: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

text.KJV: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
text.ASV: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
text.WEB: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

text.KJV: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
text.ASV: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the sons of the mighty is like unto Jehovah,
text.WEB: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

text.KJV: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
text.ASV: A God very terrible in the council of the holy ones, And to be feared above all them that are round about him?
text.WEB: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

text.KJV: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
text.ASV: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.
text.WEB: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

text.KJV: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
text.ASV: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
text.WEB: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

text.KJV: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
text.ASV: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.
text.WEB: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

text.KJV: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
text.ASV: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
text.WEB: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

text.KJV: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
text.ASV: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.
text.WEB: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

text.KJV: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
text.ASV: Thou hast a mighty arm; Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
text.WEB: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

text.KJV: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
text.ASV: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of thy throne: Lovingkindness and truth go before thy face.
text.WEB: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

text.KJV: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
text.ASV: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.
text.WEB: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

text.KJV: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
text.ASV: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.
text.WEB: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

text.KJV: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
text.ASV: For thou art the glory of their strength; And in thy favor our horn shall be exalted.
text.WEB: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

text.KJV: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
text.ASV: For our shield belongeth unto Jehovah; And our king to the Holy One of Israel.
text.WEB: For our shield belongs to Yahweh; our king to the Holy One of Israel.

text.KJV: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
text.ASV: Then thou spakest in vision to thy saints, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
text.WEB: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

text.KJV: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
text.ASV: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:
text.WEB: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

text.KJV: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
text.ASV: With whom my hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.
text.WEB: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

text.KJV: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
text.ASV: The enemy shall not exact from him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
text.WEB: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

text.KJV: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
text.ASV: And I will beat down his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.
text.WEB: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

text.KJV: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
text.ASV: But my faithfulness and my lovingkindness shall be with him; And in my name shall his horn be exalted.
text.WEB: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

text.KJV: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
text.ASV: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.
text.WEB: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

text.KJV: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
text.ASV: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.
text.WEB: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

text.KJV: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
text.ASV: I also will make him `my' first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.
text.WEB: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

text.KJV: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
text.ASV: My lovingkindness will I keep for him for evermore; And my covenant shall stand fast with him.
text.WEB: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

text.KJV: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
text.ASV: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
text.WEB: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

text.KJV: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
text.ASV: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in mine ordinances;
text.WEB: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

text.KJV: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
text.ASV: If they break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;
text.WEB: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

text.KJV: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
text.ASV: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.
text.WEB: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

text.KJV: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
text.ASV: But my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
text.WEB: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

text.KJV: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
text.ASV: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
text.WEB: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

text.KJV: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
text.ASV: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David:
text.WEB: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

text.KJV: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
text.ASV: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.
text.WEB: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

text.KJV: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
text.ASV: It shall be established for ever as the moon, And `as' the faithful witness in the sky. Selah
text.WEB: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

text.KJV: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
text.ASV: But thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
text.WEB: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

text.KJV: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
text.ASV: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown `by casting it' to the ground.
text.WEB: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

text.KJV: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
text.ASV: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.
text.WEB: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

text.KJV: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
text.ASV: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.
text.WEB: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

text.KJV: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
text.ASV: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
text.WEB: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

text.KJV: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
text.ASV: Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.
text.WEB: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

text.KJV: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
text.ASV: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.
text.WEB: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

text.KJV: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
text.ASV: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah
text.WEB: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

text.KJV: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
text.ASV: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? `How long' shall thy wrath burn like fire?
text.WEB: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

text.KJV: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
text.ASV: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!
text.WEB: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!

text.KJV: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
text.ASV: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
text.WEB: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

text.KJV: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
text.ASV: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?
text.WEB: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

text.KJV: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
text.ASV: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom `the reproach of' all the mighty peoples,
text.WEB: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

text.KJV: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
text.ASV: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
text.WEB: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen. Psalm 90 A Prayer of Moses the man of God.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.

text.KJV: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
text.ASV: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.
text.WEB: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

text.KJV: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
text.ASV: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
text.WEB: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

text.KJV: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
text.ASV: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.
text.WEB: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

text.KJV: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
text.ASV: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
text.WEB: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

text.KJV: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
text.ASV: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
text.WEB: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

text.KJV: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
text.ASV: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
text.WEB: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

text.KJV: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
text.ASV: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.
text.WEB: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

text.KJV: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
text.ASV: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
text.WEB: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

text.KJV: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
text.ASV: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
text.WEB: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

text.KJV: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
text.ASV: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.
text.WEB: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

text.KJV: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
text.ASV: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?
text.WEB: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

text.KJV: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
text.ASV: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
text.WEB: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

text.KJV: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
text.ASV: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
text.WEB: Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

text.KJV: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
text.ASV: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
text.WEB: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

text.KJV: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
text.ASV: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.
text.WEB: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

text.KJV: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
text.ASV: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.
text.WEB: Let your work appear to your servants; your glory to their children.

text.KJV: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
text.ASV: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
text.WEB: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.

text.KJV: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
text.ASV: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
text.WEB: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

text.KJV: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
text.ASV: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.
text.WEB: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

text.KJV: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
text.ASV: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.
text.WEB: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

text.KJV: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
text.ASV: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.
text.WEB: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
text.ASV: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
text.WEB: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;

text.KJV: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
text.ASV: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
text.WEB: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

text.KJV: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
text.ASV: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; `But' it shall not come nigh thee.
text.WEB: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

text.KJV: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
text.ASV: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.
text.WEB: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

text.KJV: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
text.ASV: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;
text.WEB: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

text.KJV: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
text.ASV: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
text.WEB: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

text.KJV: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
text.ASV: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
text.WEB: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

text.KJV: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
text.ASV: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
text.WEB: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

text.KJV: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
text.ASV: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.
text.WEB: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

text.KJV: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
text.ASV: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
text.WEB: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

text.KJV: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
text.ASV: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.
text.WEB: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

text.KJV: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
text.ASV: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation. Psalm 92 A Psalm, a Song for the sabbath day.
text.WEB: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

text.KJV: IT IS A GOOD THING TO GIVE THANKS UNTO THE LORD, AND TO SING PRAISES UNTO THY NAME, O MOST HIGH:
text.ASV: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;
text.WEB: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High;

text.KJV: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
text.ASV: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,
text.WEB: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

text.KJV: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
text.ASV: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.
text.WEB: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

text.KJV: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
text.ASV: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
text.WEB: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

text.KJV: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
text.ASV: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.
text.WEB: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.

text.KJV: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
text.ASV: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:
text.WEB: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

text.KJV: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
text.ASV: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.
text.WEB: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

text.KJV: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
text.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.
text.WEB: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.

text.KJV: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
text.ASV: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
text.WEB: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

text.KJV: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
text.ASV: But my horn hast thou exalted like `the horn of' the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.
text.WEB: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

text.KJV: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
text.ASV: Mine eye also hath seen `my desire' on mine enemies, Mine ears have heard `my desire' of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
text.WEB: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

text.KJV: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
text.ASV: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
text.WEB: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.KJV: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
text.ASV: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.
text.WEB: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

text.KJV: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
text.ASV: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:
text.WEB: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

text.KJV: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
text.ASV: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
text.WEB: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

text.KJV: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
text.ASV: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.
text.WEB: Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

text.KJV: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
text.ASV: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.
text.WEB: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

text.KJV: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
text.ASV: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.
text.WEB: The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

text.KJV: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
text.ASV: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.
text.WEB: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.

text.KJV: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
text.ASV: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.
text.WEB: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.

text.KJV: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.
text.WEB: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

text.KJV: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
text.ASV: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud `their' desert.
text.WEB: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

text.KJV: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
text.ASV: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?
text.WEB: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

text.KJV: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
text.ASV: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.
text.WEB: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

text.KJV: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
text.ASV: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.
text.WEB: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.

text.KJV: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
text.ASV: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.
text.WEB: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

text.KJV: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
text.ASV: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.
text.WEB: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

text.KJV: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
text.ASV: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?
text.WEB: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

text.KJV: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
text.ASV: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?
text.WEB: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

text.KJV: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
text.ASV: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, `Even' he that teacheth man knowledge?
text.WEB: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

text.KJV: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
text.ASV: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
text.WEB: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

text.KJV: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
text.ASV: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;
text.WEB: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law;

text.KJV: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
text.ASV: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.
text.WEB: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

text.KJV: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
text.ASV: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.
text.WEB: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

text.KJV: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
text.ASV: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
text.WEB: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

text.KJV: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
text.ASV: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
text.WEB: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

text.KJV: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
text.ASV: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.
text.WEB: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

text.KJV: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
text.ASV: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.
text.WEB: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

text.KJV: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
text.ASV: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.
text.WEB: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

text.KJV: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
text.ASV: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?
text.WEB: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

text.KJV: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
text.ASV: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.
