text.WEB: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

text.KJV: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
text.ASV: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.
text.WEB: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

text.KJV: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
text.ASV: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.
text.WEB: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.

text.KJV: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
text.ASV: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
text.WEB: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

text.KJV: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
text.ASV: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
text.WEB: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

text.KJV: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
text.ASV: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.
text.WEB: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.

text.KJV: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
text.ASV: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.
text.WEB: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

text.KJV: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
text.ASV: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.
text.WEB: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

text.KJV: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
text.ASV: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:
text.WEB: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,

text.KJV: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
text.ASV: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!
text.WEB: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

text.KJV: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
text.ASV: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;
text.WEB: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

text.KJV: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
text.ASV: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.
text.WEB: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

text.KJV: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
text.ASV: Forty years long was I grieved with `that' generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
text.WEB: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

text.KJV: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
text.ASV: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
text.WEB: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

text.KJV: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
text.ASV: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.
text.WEB: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.

text.KJV: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
text.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.
text.WEB: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

text.KJV: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
text.ASV: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
text.WEB: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

text.KJV: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
text.ASV: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.
text.WEB: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

text.KJV: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
text.ASV: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.
text.WEB: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.

text.KJV: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
text.ASV: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
text.WEB: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

text.KJV: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
text.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
text.WEB: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

text.KJV: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
text.ASV: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
text.WEB: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

text.KJV: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
text.ASV: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.
text.WEB: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

text.KJV: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
text.ASV: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.
text.WEB: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

text.KJV: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
text.ASV: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
text.WEB: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

text.KJV: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
text.ASV: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy
text.WEB: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

text.KJV: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
text.ASV: Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.
text.WEB: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

text.KJV: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
text.ASV: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.
text.WEB: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

text.KJV: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
text.ASV: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
text.WEB: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

text.KJV: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
text.ASV: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.
text.WEB: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

text.KJV: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
text.ASV: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.
text.WEB: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

text.KJV: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
text.ASV: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
text.WEB: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

text.KJV: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
text.ASV: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.
text.WEB: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

text.KJV: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
text.ASV: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.
text.WEB: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

text.KJV: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
text.ASV: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced, because of your judgments, Yahweh.

text.KJV: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
text.ASV: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.
text.WEB: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

text.KJV: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
text.ASV: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
text.WEB: You who love Yahweh, hate evil. He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

text.KJV: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
text.ASV: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
text.WEB: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

text.KJV: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
text.ASV: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial `name'. Psalm 98 A Psalm.
text.WEB: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

text.KJV: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
text.ASV: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.
text.WEB: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand, and his holy arm, have worked salvation for him.

text.KJV: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.
text.WEB: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

text.KJV: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
text.ASV: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
text.WEB: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

text.KJV: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
text.ASV: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.
text.WEB: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

text.KJV: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
text.ASV: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.
text.WEB: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

text.KJV: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
text.ASV: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.
text.WEB: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
text.ASV: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
text.WEB: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

text.KJV: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
text.ASV: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together
text.WEB: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

text.KJV: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
text.ASV: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.
text.WEB: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

text.KJV: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
text.ASV: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth `above' the cherubim; let the earth be moved.
text.WEB: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

text.KJV: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
text.ASV: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.
text.WEB: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

text.KJV: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
text.ASV: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.
text.WEB: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

text.KJV: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
text.ASV: The king's strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.
text.WEB: The King’s strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

text.KJV: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
text.ASV: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.
text.WEB: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

text.KJV: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
text.ASV: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.
text.WEB: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; they called on Yahweh, and he answered them.

text.KJV: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
text.ASV: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.
text.WEB: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

text.KJV: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
text.ASV: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
text.WEB: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

text.KJV: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
text.ASV: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy. Psalm 100 A Psalm of thanksgiving.
text.WEB: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!

text.KJV: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
text.ASV: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.
text.WEB: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!

text.KJV: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
text.ASV: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
text.WEB: Serve Yahweh with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

text.KJV: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
text.ASV: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
text.WEB: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

text.KJV: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
text.ASV: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
text.WEB: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

text.KJV: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
text.ASV: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations. Psalm 101 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

text.KJV: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
text.ASV: I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.
text.WEB: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

text.KJV: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
text.ASV: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way: Oh when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
text.WEB: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

text.KJV: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
text.ASV: I will set no base thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; It shall not cleave unto me.
text.WEB: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

text.KJV: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
text.ASV: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.
text.WEB: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

text.KJV: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
text.ASV: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.
text.WEB: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is haughty and conceited.

text.KJV: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
text.ASV: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall minister unto me.
text.WEB: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

text.KJV: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
text.ASV: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
text.WEB: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

text.KJV: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
text.ASV: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; To cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah. Psalm 102 A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah.
text.WEB: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.

text.KJV: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
text.ASV: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.
text.WEB: Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.

text.KJV: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
text.ASV: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.
text.WEB: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

text.KJV: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
text.ASV: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.
text.WEB: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

text.KJV: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
text.ASV: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.
text.WEB: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

text.KJV: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
text.ASV: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.
text.WEB: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

text.KJV: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
text.ASV: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
text.WEB: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

text.KJV: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
text.ASV: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.
text.WEB: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

text.KJV: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
text.ASV: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.
text.WEB: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

text.KJV: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.
text.ASV: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
text.WEB: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

text.KJV: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
text.ASV: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.
text.WEB: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.

text.KJV: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
text.ASV: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.
text.WEB: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

text.KJV: But thou, O LORD, shall endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
text.ASV: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial `name' unto all generations.
text.WEB: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

text.KJV: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
text.ASV: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.
text.WEB: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

text.KJV: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
text.ASV: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.
text.WEB: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

text.KJV: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
text.ASV: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.
text.WEB: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name; all the kings of the earth your glory.

text.KJV: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
text.ASV: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.
text.WEB: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

text.KJV: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
text.ASV: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.
text.WEB: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

text.KJV: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
text.ASV: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.
text.WEB: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.

text.KJV: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
text.ASV: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;
text.WEB: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;

text.KJV: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
text.ASV: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;
text.WEB: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;

text.KJV: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
text.ASV: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;
text.WEB: that men may declare Yahweh’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

text.KJV: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
text.ASV: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.
text.WEB: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve Yahweh.

text.KJV: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
text.ASV: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
text.WEB: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

text.KJV: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
text.ASV: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.
text.WEB: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

text.KJV: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
text.ASV: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.
text.WEB: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

text.KJV: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
text.ASV: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
text.WEB: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

text.KJV: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
text.ASV: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.
text.WEB: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

text.KJV: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
text.ASV: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee. Psalm 103 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

text.KJV: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
text.ASV: Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, `bless' his holy name.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

text.KJV: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
text.ASV: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits;

text.KJV: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
text.ASV: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;
text.WEB: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;

text.KJV: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
text.ASV: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
text.WEB: who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;

text.KJV: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
text.ASV: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, `So that' thy youth is renewed like the eagle.
text.WEB: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

text.KJV: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
text.ASV: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.
text.WEB: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

text.KJV: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
text.ASV: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.
text.WEB: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

text.KJV: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
text.ASV: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.
text.WEB: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

text.KJV: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
text.ASV: He will not always chide; Neither will he keep `his anger' for ever.
text.WEB: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

text.KJV: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
text.ASV: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.
text.WEB: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

text.KJV: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
text.ASV: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.
text.WEB: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

text.KJV: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
text.ASV: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
text.WEB: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

text.KJV: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
text.ASV: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.
text.WEB: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.

text.KJV: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
text.ASV: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.
text.WEB: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

text.KJV: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
text.ASV: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
text.WEB: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

text.KJV: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
text.ASV: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.
text.WEB: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

text.KJV: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
text.ASV: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children's children;
text.WEB: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children;

text.KJV: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
text.ASV: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.
text.WEB: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

text.KJV: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.
text.WEB: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

text.KJV: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
text.ASV: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

text.KJV: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
text.ASV: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

text.KJV: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
text.ASV: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!

text.KJV: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
text.ASV: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:
text.WEB: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

text.KJV: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
text.ASV: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;
text.WEB: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

text.KJV: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
text.ASV: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;
text.WEB: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

text.KJV: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
text.ASV: Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;
text.WEB: He makes his messengers winds; his servants flames of fire.

text.KJV: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
text.ASV: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.
text.WEB: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

text.KJV: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
text.ASV: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.
text.WEB: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

text.KJV: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
text.ASV: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away
text.WEB: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

text.KJV: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
text.ASV: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.
text.WEB: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

text.KJV: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
text.ASV: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.
text.WEB: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

text.KJV: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
text.ASV: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;
text.WEB: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

text.KJV: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
text.ASV: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.
text.WEB: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

text.KJV: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
text.ASV: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.
text.WEB: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

text.KJV: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
text.ASV: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.
text.WEB: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

text.KJV: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
text.ASV: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,
text.WEB: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

text.KJV: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
text.ASV: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, `And' oil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man's heart.
text.WEB: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

text.KJV: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
text.ASV: The trees of Jehovah are filled `with moisture', The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
text.WEB: Yahweh’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;

text.KJV: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
text.ASV: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
text.WEB: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

text.KJV: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
text.ASV: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.
text.WEB: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

text.KJV: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
text.ASV: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.
text.WEB: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

text.KJV: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
text.ASV: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.
text.WEB: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

text.KJV: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
text.ASV: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
text.WEB: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

text.KJV: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
text.ASV: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.
text.WEB: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lay down in their dens.

text.KJV: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
text.ASV: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.
text.WEB: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

text.KJV: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.
text.WEB: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

text.KJV: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
text.ASV: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.
text.WEB: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

text.KJV: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
text.ASV: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play therein.
text.WEB: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

text.KJV: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
text.ASV: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.
text.WEB: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

text.KJV: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
text.ASV: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.
text.WEB: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

text.KJV: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
text.ASV: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.
text.WEB: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.

text.KJV: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
text.ASV: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.
text.WEB: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

text.KJV: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
text.ASV: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:
text.WEB: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

text.KJV: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
text.ASV: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
text.WEB: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

text.KJV: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
text.ASV: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
text.WEB: I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

text.KJV: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
text.ASV: Let thy meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.
text.WEB: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in Yahweh.

text.KJV: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless Yahweh, my soul. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.
text.WEB: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

text.KJV: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
text.ASV: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvelous works.
text.WEB: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

text.KJV: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
text.ASV: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.
text.WEB: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

text.KJV: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
text.ASV: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
text.WEB: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

text.KJV: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
text.ASV: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
text.WEB: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

text.KJV: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
text.ASV: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
text.WEB: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

text.KJV: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
text.ASV: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.
text.WEB: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

text.KJV: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
text.ASV: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,
text.WEB: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

text.KJV: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
text.ASV: `The covenant' which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,
text.WEB: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

text.KJV: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
text.ASV: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,
text.WEB: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

text.KJV: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
text.ASV: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;
text.WEB: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance”;

text.KJV: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
text.ASV: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.
text.WEB: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

text.KJV: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
text.ASV: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.
text.WEB: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

text.KJV: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
text.ASV: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
text.WEB: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

text.KJV: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
text.ASV: `Saying', Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.
text.WEB: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

text.KJV: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
text.ASV: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.
text.WEB: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

text.KJV: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
text.ASV: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:
text.WEB: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

text.KJV: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
text.ASV: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in `chains of' iron,
text.WEB: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

text.KJV: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
text.ASV: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.
text.WEB: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.

text.KJV: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
text.ASV: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
text.WEB: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

text.KJV: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
text.ASV: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;
text.WEB: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;

text.KJV: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
text.ASV: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
text.WEB: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

text.KJV: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
text.ASV: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
text.WEB: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

text.KJV: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
text.ASV: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.
text.WEB: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

text.KJV: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
text.ASV: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.
text.WEB: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

text.KJV: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
text.ASV: He sent Moses his servant, `And' Aaron whom he had chosen.
text.WEB: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

text.KJV: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
text.ASV: They set among them his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
text.WEB: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

text.KJV: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
text.ASV: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.
text.WEB: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

text.KJV: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
text.ASV: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.
text.WEB: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

text.KJV: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
text.ASV: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.
text.WEB: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

text.KJV: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
text.ASV: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.
text.WEB: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

text.KJV: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
text.ASV: He gave them hail for rain, `And' flaming fire in their land.
text.WEB: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

text.KJV: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
text.ASV: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.
text.WEB: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

text.KJV: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
text.ASV: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,
text.WEB: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,

text.KJV: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
text.ASV: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.
text.WEB: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.

text.KJV: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
text.ASV: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.
text.WEB: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

text.KJV: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
text.ASV: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.
text.WEB: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

text.KJV: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
text.ASV: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
text.WEB: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

text.KJV: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
text.ASV: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.
text.WEB: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

text.KJV: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
text.ASV: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
text.WEB: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

text.KJV: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
text.ASV: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places `like' a river.
text.WEB: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

text.KJV: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
text.ASV: For he remembered his holy word, `And' Abraham his servant.
text.WEB: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

text.KJV: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
text.ASV: And he brought forth his people with joy, `And' his chosen with singing.
text.WEB: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

text.KJV: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
text.ASV: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:
text.WEB: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

text.KJV: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness `endureth' forever.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
text.ASV: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?
text.WEB: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?

text.KJV: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
text.ASV: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.
text.WEB: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

text.KJV: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
text.ASV: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,
text.WEB: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

text.KJV: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
text.ASV: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.
text.WEB: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

text.KJV: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
text.ASV: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
text.WEB: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

text.KJV: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
text.ASV: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
text.WEB: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

text.KJV: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
text.ASV: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.
text.WEB: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

text.KJV: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
text.ASV: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.
text.WEB: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

text.KJV: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
text.ASV: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
text.WEB: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

text.KJV: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
text.ASV: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.
text.WEB: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

text.KJV: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
text.ASV: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.
text.WEB: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

text.KJV: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
text.ASV: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel,
text.WEB: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

text.KJV: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
text.ASV: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.
text.WEB: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

text.KJV: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
text.ASV: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.
text.WEB: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

text.KJV: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
text.ASV: They envied Moses also in the camp, `And' Aaron the saint of Jehovah.
text.WEB: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.

text.KJV: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan and covered the company of Abiram.
text.ASV: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.
text.WEB: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

text.KJV: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
text.ASV: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
text.WEB: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

text.KJV: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
text.ASV: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.
text.WEB: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

text.KJV: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
text.ASV: Thus they changed their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.
text.WEB: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

text.KJV: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
text.ASV: They forgat God their Saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt,
text.WEB: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

text.KJV: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
text.ASV: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, `And' terrible things by the Red Sea.
text.WEB: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

text.KJV: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
text.ASV: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy `them'.
text.WEB: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

text.KJV: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
text.ASV: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word,
text.WEB: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

text.KJV: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
text.ASV: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.
text.WEB: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.

text.KJV: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
text.ASV: Therefore he sware unto them, That he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
text.WEB: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

text.KJV: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
text.ASV: And that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.
text.WEB: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

text.KJV: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
text.ASV: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.
text.WEB: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

text.KJV: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
text.ASV: Thus they provoked him to anger with their doings; And the plague brake in upon them.
text.WEB: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

text.KJV: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
text.ASV: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.
text.WEB: Then Phinehas stood up, and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

text.KJV: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
text.ASV: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for evermore.
text.WEB: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

text.KJV: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
text.ASV: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;
text.WEB: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

text.KJV: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
text.ASV: Because they were rebellious against his spirit, And he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
text.WEB: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

text.KJV: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
text.ASV: They did not destroy the peoples, As Jehovah commanded them,
text.WEB: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,

text.KJV: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
text.ASV: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works,
text.WEB: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

text.KJV: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
text.ASV: And served their idols, Which became a snare unto them.
text.WEB: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

text.KJV: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
text.ASV: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
text.WEB: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

text.KJV: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
text.ASV: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
text.WEB: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

text.KJV: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
text.ASV: Thus were they defiled with their works, And played the harlot in their doings.
text.WEB: Thus were they defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

text.KJV: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
text.ASV: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.
text.WEB: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

text.KJV: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
text.ASV: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.
text.WEB: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

text.KJV: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
text.ASV: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.
text.WEB: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

text.KJV: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
text.ASV: Many times did he deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And were brought low in their iniquity.
text.WEB: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

text.KJV: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
text.ASV: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, When he heard their cry:
text.WEB: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

text.KJV: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
text.ASV: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
text.WEB: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

text.KJV: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
text.ASV: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.
text.WEB: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

text.KJV: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
text.ASV: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.
text.WEB: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!

text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: O give thanks unto Jehovah; For he is good; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
text.ASV: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say `so', Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
text.WEB: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

text.KJV: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
text.ASV: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
text.WEB: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

text.KJV: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
text.ASV: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.
text.WEB: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

text.KJV: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
text.ASV: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
text.WEB: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

text.KJV: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
text.ASV: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,
text.WEB: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,

text.KJV: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
text.ASV: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.
text.WEB: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

text.KJV: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.WEB: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

text.KJV: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
text.ASV: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.
text.WEB: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

text.KJV: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
text.ASV: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,
text.WEB: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

text.KJV: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
text.ASV: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:
text.WEB: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

text.KJV: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
text.ASV: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.
text.WEB: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

text.KJV: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
text.ASV: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.
text.WEB: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

text.KJV: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
text.ASV: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.
text.WEB: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

text.KJV: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.WEB: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

text.KJV: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
text.ASV: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.
text.WEB: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.

text.KJV: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
text.ASV: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
text.WEB: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

text.KJV: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
text.ASV: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.
text.WEB: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

text.KJV: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
text.ASV: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.
text.WEB: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.

text.KJV: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
text.ASV: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth `them' from their destructions.
text.WEB: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

text.KJV: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.WEB: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

text.KJV: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
text.ASV: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.
text.WEB: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

text.KJV: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
text.ASV: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;
text.WEB: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;

text.KJV: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
text.ASV: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.
text.WEB: These see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

text.KJV: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
text.ASV: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.
text.WEB: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

text.KJV: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
text.ASV: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.
text.WEB: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

text.KJV: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
text.ASV: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits' end.
text.WEB: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

text.KJV: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
text.ASV: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.
text.WEB: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

text.KJV: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
text.ASV: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.
text.WEB: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

text.KJV: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
