text.ASV: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
text.WEB: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

text.KJV: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.ASV: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!
text.WEB: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

text.KJV: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
text.ASV: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.
text.WEB: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

text.KJV: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
text.ASV: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;
text.WEB: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

text.KJV: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
text.ASV: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
text.WEB: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

text.KJV: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
text.ASV: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.
text.WEB: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

text.KJV: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
text.ASV: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,
text.WEB: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

text.KJV: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
text.ASV: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.
text.WEB: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

text.KJV: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
text.ASV: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
text.WEB: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

text.KJV: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
text.ASV: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
text.WEB: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

text.KJV: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
text.ASV: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.
text.WEB: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

text.KJV: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
text.ASV: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh `him' families like a flock.
text.WEB: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

text.KJV: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
text.ASV: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
text.WEB: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

text.KJV: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
text.ASV: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah. Psalm 108 A Song, A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.

text.KJV: O god, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
text.ASV: My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
text.WEB: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

text.KJV: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
text.ASV: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.
text.WEB: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

text.KJV: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
text.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
text.WEB: I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

text.KJV: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
text.ASV: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth `reacheth' unto the skies.
text.WEB: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

text.KJV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
text.ASV: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.
text.WEB: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

text.KJV: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
text.ASV: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.
text.WEB: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

text.KJV: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
text.ASV: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
text.WEB: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

text.KJV: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
text.ASV: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
text.WEB: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

text.KJV: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
text.ASV: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.
text.WEB: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

text.KJV: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
text.ASV: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
text.WEB: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?

text.KJV: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
text.ASV: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
text.WEB: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

text.KJV: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
text.ASV: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
text.WEB: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

text.KJV: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
text.ASV: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries. Psalm 109 For the Chief Musicion. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.

text.KJV: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
text.ASV: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
text.WEB: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

text.KJV: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
text.ASV: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.
text.WEB: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

text.KJV: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
text.ASV: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
text.WEB: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

text.KJV: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
text.ASV: For my love they are my adversaries: But I `give myself unto' prayer.
text.WEB: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

text.KJV: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
text.ASV: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.
text.WEB: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

text.KJV: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
text.ASV: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.
text.WEB: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

text.KJV: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
text.ASV: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.
text.WEB: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

text.KJV: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
text.ASV: Let his days be few; `And' let another take his office.
text.WEB: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

text.KJV: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
text.ASV: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.
text.WEB: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

text.KJV: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
text.ASV: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek `their bread' out of their desolate places.
text.WEB: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

text.KJV: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
text.ASV: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.
text.WEB: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

text.KJV: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
text.ASV: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.
text.WEB: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

text.KJV: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
text.ASV: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
text.WEB: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

text.KJV: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
text.ASV: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
text.WEB: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

text.KJV: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
text.ASV: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;
text.WEB: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

text.KJV: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
text.ASV: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay `them'.
text.WEB: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

text.KJV: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
text.ASV: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.
text.WEB: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

text.KJV: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
text.ASV: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
text.WEB: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

text.KJV: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
text.ASV: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
text.WEB: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

text.KJV: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
text.ASV: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.
text.WEB: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.

text.KJV: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
text.ASV: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name's sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;
text.WEB: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

text.KJV: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
text.ASV: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
text.WEB: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

text.KJV: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
text.ASV: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
text.WEB: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

text.KJV: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
text.ASV: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.
text.WEB: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

text.KJV: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
text.ASV: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.
text.WEB: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

text.KJV: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
text.ASV: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:
text.WEB: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

text.KJV: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
text.ASV: That they may know that this is thy hand; `That' thou, Jehovah, hast done it.
text.WEB: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.

text.KJV: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
text.ASV: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.
text.WEB: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

text.KJV: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
text.ASV: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
text.WEB: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

text.KJV: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
text.ASV: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
text.WEB: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

text.KJV: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
text.ASV: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul. Psalm 110 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

text.KJV: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
text.ASV: Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
text.WEB: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

text.KJV: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
text.ASV: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
text.WEB: Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

text.KJV: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
text.ASV: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.
text.WEB: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

text.KJV: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
text.WEB: Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

text.KJV: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
text.ASV: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
text.WEB: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

text.KJV: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
text.ASV: He will judge among the nations, He will fill `the places' with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.
text.WEB: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

text.KJV: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
text.ASV: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.
text.WEB: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
text.WEB: Praise Yah! is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise Yah!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav). I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

text.KJV: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
text.ASV: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
text.WEB: Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

text.KJV: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
text.ASV: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
text.WEB: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

text.KJV: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
text.ASV: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.
text.WEB: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.

text.KJV: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
text.ASV: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.
text.WEB: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

text.KJV: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
text.ASV: He hath showed his people the power of his works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.
text.WEB: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

text.KJV: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
text.ASV: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.
text.WEB: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

text.KJV: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
text.ASV: They are established for ever and ever; They are done in truth and uprightness.
text.WEB: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

text.KJV: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
text.ASV: He hath sent redemption unto his people; He hath commanded his covenant for ever: Holy and reverend is his name.
text.WEB: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

text.KJV: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
text.ASV: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do `his commandments': His praise endureth for ever.
text.WEB: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
text.WEB: Praise Yah! is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise Yah!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav). Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.

text.KJV: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
text.ASV: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
text.WEB: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

text.KJV: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
text.WEB: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

text.KJV: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
text.ASV: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: `He is' gracious, and merciful, and righteous.
text.WEB: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

text.KJV: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
text.ASV: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.
text.WEB: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

text.KJV: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
text.ASV: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
text.WEB: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

text.KJV: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
text.ASV: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.
text.WEB: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

text.KJV: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
text.ASV: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see `his desire' upon his adversaries.
text.WEB: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

text.KJV: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
text.ASV: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
text.WEB: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

text.KJV: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
text.ASV: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
text.WEB: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.

text.KJV: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
text.ASV: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

text.KJV: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD's name is to be praised.
text.ASV: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah's name is to be praised.
text.WEB: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, Yahweh’s name is to be praised.

text.KJV: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
text.ASV: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.
text.WEB: Yahweh is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

text.KJV: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
text.ASV: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,
text.WEB: Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,

text.KJV: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
text.ASV: That humbleth himself to behold `The things that are' in heaven and in the earth?
text.WEB: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?

text.KJV: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
text.ASV: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;
text.WEB: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;

text.KJV: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
text.ASV: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.
text.WEB: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

text.KJV: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, `And to be' a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: He settles the barren woman in her home, as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
text.ASV: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
text.WEB: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language;

text.KJV: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
text.ASV: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
text.WEB: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

text.KJV: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
text.ASV: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.
text.WEB: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

text.KJV: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
text.ASV: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.
text.WEB: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

text.KJV: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
text.ASV: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?
text.WEB: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

text.KJV: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
text.ASV: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?
text.WEB: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?

text.KJV: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
text.ASV: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,
text.WEB: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

text.KJV: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
text.ASV: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
text.WEB: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

text.KJV: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
text.ASV: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth's sake.
text.WEB: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

text.KJV: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
text.ASV: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?
text.WEB: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

text.KJV: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
text.ASV: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.
text.WEB: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

text.KJV: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
text.ASV: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.
text.WEB: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

text.KJV: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
text.ASV: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
text.WEB: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

text.KJV: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
text.ASV: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;
text.WEB: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

text.KJV: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
text.ASV: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.
text.WEB: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

text.KJV: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
text.ASV: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
text.WEB: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

text.KJV: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
text.ASV: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
text.WEB: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

text.KJV: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
text.ASV: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
text.WEB: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

text.KJV: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
text.ASV: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
text.WEB: You who fear Yahweh, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

text.KJV: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless `us': He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
text.WEB: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

text.KJV: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
text.ASV: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.
text.WEB: He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

text.KJV: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
text.ASV: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.
text.WEB: May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.

text.KJV: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
text.ASV: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
text.WEB: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

text.KJV: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
text.ASV: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.
text.WEB: The heavens are the heavens of Yahweh; but the earth has he given to the children of men.

text.KJV: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
text.ASV: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;
text.WEB: The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;

text.KJV: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
text.ASV: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: But we will bless Yah, from this time forward and forever more. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
text.ASV: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.
text.WEB: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

text.KJV: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
text.ASV: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call `upon him' as long as I live.
text.WEB: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

text.KJV: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
text.ASV: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
text.WEB: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

text.KJV: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
text.ASV: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
text.WEB: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

text.KJV: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
text.ASV: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.
text.WEB: Yahweh is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

text.KJV: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
text.ASV: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.
text.WEB: Yahweh preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

text.KJV: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
text.ASV: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.
text.WEB: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.

text.KJV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
text.ASV: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, `And' my feet from falling.
text.WEB: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

text.KJV: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
text.ASV: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.
text.WEB: I will walk before Yahweh in the land of the living.

text.KJV: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
text.ASV: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:
text.WEB: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

text.KJV: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
text.ASV: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
text.WEB: I said in my haste, “All men are liars.”

text.KJV: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
text.ASV: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?
text.WEB: What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?

text.KJV: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.
text.WEB: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on Yahweh’s name.

text.KJV: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
text.ASV: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.
text.WEB: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.

text.KJV: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
text.ASV: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.
text.WEB: Precious in Yahweh’s sight is the death of his saints.

text.KJV: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.
text.WEB: Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant. You have freed me from my chains.

text.KJV: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.
text.WEB: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on Yahweh’s name.

text.KJV: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
text.ASV: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,
text.WEB: I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people,

text.KJV: In the courts of the LORD's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: In the courts of Jehovah's house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
text.ASV: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

text.KJV: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovah `endureth' for ever. Praise ye Jehovah. Psalm 118
text.WEB: For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
text.ASV: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me `and set me' in a large place.
text.WEB: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

text.KJV: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
text.ASV: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?
text.WEB: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

text.KJV: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
text.ASV: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see `my desire' upon them that hate me.
text.WEB: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

text.KJV: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
text.ASV: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.
text.WEB: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.

text.KJV: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
text.ASV: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.
text.WEB: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.

text.KJV: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
text.ASV: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
text.WEB: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.

text.KJV: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
text.ASV: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
text.WEB: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.

text.KJV: They compassed me about like bees: they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
text.ASV: They compassed me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.
text.WEB: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

text.KJV: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
text.ASV: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.
text.WEB: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.

text.KJV: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
text.ASV: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.
text.WEB: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

text.KJV: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
text.ASV: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
text.WEB: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

text.KJV: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
text.ASV: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.
text.WEB: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”

text.KJV: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
text.ASV: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.
text.WEB: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.

text.KJV: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.
text.WEB: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

text.KJV: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
text.ASV: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

text.KJV: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
text.ASV: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.
text.WEB: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

text.KJV: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
text.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.
text.WEB: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

text.KJV: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
text.ASV: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.
text.WEB: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

text.KJV: This is the LORD's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
text.ASV: This is Jehovah's doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.
text.WEB: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

text.KJV: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
text.ASV: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
text.WEB: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

text.KJV: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
text.ASV: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.
text.WEB: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

text.KJV: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
text.ASV: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.

text.KJV: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
text.ASV: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
text.WEB: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

text.KJV: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
text.ASV: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
text.WEB: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
text.ASV: ALEPH. Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to Yahweh’s law.

text.KJV: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
text.ASV: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.
text.WEB: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

text.KJV: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
text.ASV: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.
text.WEB: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

text.KJV: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
text.ASV: Thou hast commanded `us' thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.
text.WEB: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

text.KJV: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
text.ASV: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!
text.WEB: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

text.KJV: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
text.ASV: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.
text.WEB: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

text.KJV: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
text.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.
text.WEB: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

text.KJV: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
text.ASV: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly.
text.WEB: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me.

text.KJV: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
text.ASV: BETH. Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed `thereto' according to thy word.
text.WEB: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

text.KJV: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
text.ASV: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.
text.WEB: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

text.KJV: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
text.ASV: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.
text.WEB: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

text.KJV: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
text.ASV: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.
text.WEB: Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

text.KJV: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
text.ASV: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.
text.WEB: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

text.KJV: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
text.ASV: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
text.WEB: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

text.KJV: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
text.ASV: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.
text.WEB: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

text.KJV: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
text.ASV: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
text.WEB: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.

text.KJV: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
text.ASV: GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.
text.WEB: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

text.KJV: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
text.ASV: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.
text.WEB: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

text.KJV: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
text.ASV: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.
text.WEB: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

text.KJV: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
text.ASV: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.
text.WEB: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

text.KJV: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
text.ASV: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.
text.WEB: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

text.KJV: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
text.ASV: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.
text.WEB: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

text.KJV: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
text.ASV: Princes also sat and talked against me; `But' thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.
text.WEB: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

text.KJV: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
text.ASV: Thy testimonies also are my delight `And' my counsellors.
text.WEB: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.

text.KJV: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
text.ASV: DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.
text.WEB: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

text.KJV: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
text.ASV: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.
text.WEB: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

text.KJV: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
text.ASV: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.
text.WEB: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

text.KJV: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
text.ASV: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
text.WEB: My soul is weary with sorrow: strengthen me according to your word.

text.KJV: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
text.ASV: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.
text.WEB: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

text.KJV: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
text.ASV: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set `before me'.
text.WEB: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

text.KJV: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
text.ASV: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.
text.WEB: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.

text.KJV: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
text.ASV: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart.
text.WEB: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.

text.KJV: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
text.ASV: HE. Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.
text.WEB: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

text.KJV: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
text.ASV: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
text.WEB: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

text.KJV: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
text.ASV: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.
text.WEB: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

text.KJV: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
text.ASV: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.
text.WEB: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

text.KJV: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
text.ASV: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.
text.WEB: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

text.KJV: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
text.ASV: Confirm unto thy servant thy word, Which `is in order' unto the fear of thee.
text.WEB: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

text.KJV: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
text.ASV: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.
text.WEB: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

text.KJV: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
text.ASV: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness.
text.WEB: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.

text.KJV: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
text.ASV: VAV. Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.
text.WEB: Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.

text.KJV: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
text.ASV: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.
text.WEB: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

text.KJV: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
text.ASV: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.
text.WEB: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

text.KJV: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
text.ASV: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.
text.WEB: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

text.KJV: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
text.ASV: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.
text.WEB: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

text.KJV: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
text.ASV: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.
text.WEB: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

text.KJV: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
text.ASV: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.
text.WEB: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

text.KJV: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
text.ASV: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes.
text.WEB: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.

text.KJV: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
text.ASV: ZAYIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.
text.WEB: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

text.KJV: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
text.ASV: This is my comfort in my affliction; For thy word hath quickened me.
text.WEB: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

text.KJV: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
text.ASV: The proud have had me greatly in derision: `Yet' have I not swerved from thy law.
text.WEB: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

text.KJV: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
text.ASV: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.
text.WEB: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

text.KJV: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
text.ASV: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
text.WEB: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

text.KJV: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
text.ASV: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
text.WEB: Your statutes have been my songs, in the house where I live.

text.KJV: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
text.ASV: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.
text.WEB: I have remembered your name, Yahweh, in the night, and I obey your law.

text.KJV: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
text.ASV: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts.
text.WEB: This is my way, that I keep your precepts.

text.KJV: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
text.ASV: HHETH. Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.
text.WEB: Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

text.KJV: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
text.ASV: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.
text.WEB: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

text.KJV: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
text.ASV: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
text.WEB: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

text.KJV: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
text.ASV: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.
text.WEB: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

text.KJV: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
text.ASV: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; `But' I have not forgotten thy law.
text.WEB: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

text.KJV: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
text.ASV: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.
text.WEB: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

text.KJV: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
text.ASV: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.
text.WEB: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

text.KJV: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
text.ASV: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes.
text.WEB: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.

text.KJV: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
text.ASV: TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.
text.WEB: Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
text.ASV: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; For I have believed in thy commandments.
text.WEB: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

text.KJV: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
text.ASV: Before I was afflicted I went astray; But now I observe thy word.
text.WEB: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

text.KJV: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
text.ASV: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.
text.WEB: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

text.KJV: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
text.ASV: The proud have forged a lie against me: With my whole heart will I keep thy precepts.
text.WEB: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

text.KJV: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
text.ASV: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.
text.WEB: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

text.KJV: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
text.ASV: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I may learn thy statutes.
text.WEB: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

text.KJV: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
text.ASV: The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.
text.WEB: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

text.KJV: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
text.ASV: YODH. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
text.WEB: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

text.KJV: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
text.ASV: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad, Because I have hoped in thy word.
text.WEB: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

text.KJV: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
text.ASV: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.
text.WEB: Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

text.KJV: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
text.ASV: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.
text.WEB: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

text.KJV: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
text.ASV: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; For thy law is my delight.
text.WEB: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

text.KJV: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
text.ASV: Let the proud be put to shame; For they have overthrown me wrongfully: `But' I will meditate on thy precepts.
text.WEB: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

text.KJV: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
text.ASV: Let those that fear thee turn unto me; And they shall know thy testimonies.
text.WEB: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

text.KJV: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
text.ASV: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame.
text.WEB: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.

text.KJV: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
text.ASV: KAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation; `But' I hope in thy word.
text.WEB: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

text.KJV: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
text.ASV: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?
text.WEB: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

text.KJV: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
text.ASV: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.
text.WEB: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

text.KJV: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
text.ASV: How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
text.WEB: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

text.KJV: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
text.ASV: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.
text.WEB: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

text.KJV: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
text.ASV: All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
text.WEB: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

text.KJV: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
text.ASV: They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.
text.WEB: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

text.KJV: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
text.ASV: LAMEDH. Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth.
text.WEB: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

text.KJV: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
text.ASV: For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.
text.WEB: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.

text.KJV: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
text.ASV: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
text.WEB: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

text.KJV: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
text.ASV: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.
text.WEB: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

text.KJV: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
text.ASV: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
text.WEB: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

text.KJV: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
text.ASV: I will never forget thy precepts; For with them thou hast quickened me.
text.WEB: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

text.KJV: I am thine, save me: for I have sought thy precepts.
text.ASV: I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.
text.WEB: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

text.KJV: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
text.ASV: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; `But' I will consider thy testimonies.
text.WEB: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

text.KJV: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
text.ASV: MEM. I have seen an end of all perfection; `But' thy commandment is exceeding broad.
text.WEB: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.

text.KJV: O how I love thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
text.ASV: Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.
text.WEB: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

text.KJV: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
text.ASV: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; For they are ever with me.
text.WEB: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

text.KJV: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
text.ASV: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For thy testimonies are my meditation.
text.WEB: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

text.KJV: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
text.ASV: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.
text.WEB: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

text.KJV: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
text.ASV: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.
text.WEB: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

text.KJV: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
text.ASV: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.
text.WEB: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

text.KJV: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
text.ASV: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! `Yea, sweeter' than honey to my mouth!
text.WEB: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

text.KJV: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
text.ASV: Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way.
text.WEB: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way.

text.KJV: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
text.ASV: NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.
text.WEB: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

text.KJV: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
text.ASV: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, That I will observe thy righteous ordinances.
text.WEB: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

text.KJV: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
text.ASV: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.
text.WEB: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

text.KJV: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
text.ASV: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me thine ordinances.
text.WEB: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. Yahweh, teach me your ordinances.

text.KJV: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
text.ASV: My soul is continually in my hand; Yet do I not forget thy law.
text.WEB: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

text.KJV: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
text.ASV: The wicked have laid a snare for me; Yet have I not gone astray from thy precepts.
text.WEB: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

text.KJV: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
text.ASV: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.
text.WEB: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

text.KJV: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
text.ASV: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, even unto the end.
text.WEB: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end.

text.KJV: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
text.ASV: SAMEKH. I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.
text.WEB: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

text.KJV: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
text.ASV: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
text.WEB: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

text.KJV: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
text.ASV: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.
text.WEB: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

text.KJV: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
text.ASV: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live; And let me not be ashamed of my hope.
text.WEB: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

text.KJV: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
text.ASV: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.
text.WEB: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

text.KJV: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
text.ASV: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is falsehood.
text.WEB: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

text.KJV: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
text.ASV: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.
text.WEB: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

text.KJV: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
text.ASV: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments.
text.WEB: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.

text.KJV: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
text.ASV: AYIN. I have done justice and righteousness: Leave me not to mine oppressors.
text.WEB: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

text.KJV: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
text.ASV: Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.
text.WEB: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

text.KJV: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
text.ASV: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.
text.WEB: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

text.KJV: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
text.ASV: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.
text.WEB: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

text.KJV: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
text.ASV: I am thy servant; give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.
text.WEB: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

text.KJV: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
text.ASV: It is time for Jehovah to work; `For' they have made void thy law.
text.WEB: It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
