text.KJV: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
text.ASV: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.
text.WEB: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

text.KJV: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
text.ASV: Therefore I esteem all `thy' precepts concerning all `things' to be right; `And' I hate every false way.
text.WEB: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.

text.KJV: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
text.ASV: PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
text.WEB: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

text.KJV: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
text.ASV: The opening of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.
text.WEB: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

text.KJV: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
text.ASV: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.
text.WEB: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

text.KJV: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
text.ASV: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
text.WEB: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

text.KJV: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
text.ASV: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
text.WEB: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

text.KJV: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
text.ASV: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.
text.WEB: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

text.KJV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
text.ASV: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.
text.WEB: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

text.KJV: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
text.ASV: Streams of water run down mine eyes, Because they observe not thy law.
text.WEB: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law.

text.KJV: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
text.ASV: TSADHE. Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright are thy judgments.
text.WEB: You are righteous, Yahweh. Your judgments are upright.

text.KJV: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
text.ASV: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness And very faithfulness.
text.WEB: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

text.KJV: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
text.ASV: My zeal hath consumed me, Because mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.
text.WEB: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

text.KJV: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
text.ASV: Thy word is very pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.
text.WEB: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

text.KJV: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
text.ASV: I am small and despised; `Yet' do I not forget thy precepts.
text.WEB: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

text.KJV: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
text.ASV: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is truth.
text.WEB: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

text.KJV: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
text.ASV: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; `Yet' thy commandments are my delight.
text.WEB: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

text.KJV: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
text.ASV: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever: Give me understanding, and I shall live.
text.WEB: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.

text.KJV: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
text.ASV: QOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.
text.WEB: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, Yahweh! I will keep your statutes.

text.KJV: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
text.ASV: I have called unto thee; save me, And I shall observe thy testimonies.
text.WEB: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

text.KJV: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
text.ASV: I anticipated the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy words.
text.WEB: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

text.KJV: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
text.ASV: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.
text.WEB: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

text.KJV: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
text.ASV: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thine ordinances.
text.WEB: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your ordinances.

text.KJV: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
text.ASV: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.
text.WEB: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

text.KJV: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
text.ASV: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.
text.WEB: You are near, Yahweh. All your commandments are truth.

text.KJV: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
text.ASV: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever.
text.WEB: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.

text.KJV: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
text.ASV: RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.
text.WEB: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

text.KJV: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
text.ASV: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.
text.WEB: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

text.KJV: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
text.ASV: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.
text.WEB: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

text.KJV: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
text.ASV: Great are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah: Quicken me according to thine ordinances.
text.WEB: Great are your tender mercies, Yahweh. Revive me according to your ordinances.

text.KJV: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
text.ASV: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; `Yet' have I not swerved from thy testimonies.
text.WEB: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

text.KJV: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
text.ASV: I beheld the treacherous, and was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.
text.WEB: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

text.KJV: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
text.ASV: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.
text.WEB: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.

text.KJV: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
text.ASV: The sum of thy word is truth; And every one of thy righteous ordinances `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.

text.KJV: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
text.ASV: SHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.
text.WEB: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

text.KJV: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
text.ASV: I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
text.WEB: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

text.KJV: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
text.ASV: I hate and abhor falsehood; `But' thy law do I love.
text.WEB: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

text.KJV: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
text.ASV: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.
text.WEB: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

text.KJV: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
text.ASV: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.
text.WEB: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

text.KJV: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
text.ASV: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.
text.WEB: I have hoped for your salvation, Yahweh. I have done your commandments.

text.KJV: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
text.ASV: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.
text.WEB: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

text.KJV: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
text.ASV: I have observed thy precepts and thy testimonies; For all my ways are before thee.
text.WEB: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you.

text.KJV: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
text.ASV: TAV. Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.
text.WEB: Let my cry come before you, Yahweh. Give me understanding according to your word.

text.KJV: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
text.ASV: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.
text.WEB: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

text.KJV: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
text.ASV: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.
text.WEB: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

text.KJV: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
text.ASV: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.
text.WEB: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

text.KJV: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
text.ASV: Let thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.
text.WEB: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

text.KJV: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
text.ASV: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.
text.WEB: I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.

text.KJV: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
text.ASV: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thine ordinances help me.
text.WEB: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

text.KJV: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
text.ASV: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; Seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments. Psalm 120 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

text.KJV: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
text.ASV: In my distress I cried unto Jehovah, And he answered me.
text.WEB: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.

text.KJV: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
text.ASV: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, `And' from a deceitful tongue.
text.WEB: Deliver my soul, Yahweh, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

text.KJV: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
text.ASV: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?
text.WEB: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

text.KJV: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
text.ASV: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of juniper.
text.WEB: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

text.KJV: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
text.ASV: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
text.WEB: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

text.KJV: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
text.ASV: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.
text.WEB: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

text.KJV: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
text.ASV: I am `for' peace: But when I speak, they are for war. Psalm 121 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

text.KJV: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
text.ASV: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
text.WEB: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

text.KJV: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
text.ASV: My help `cometh' from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.
text.WEB: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

text.KJV: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
text.ASV: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.
text.WEB: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

text.KJV: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
text.ASV: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
text.WEB: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

text.KJV: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
text.ASV: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.
text.WEB: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.

text.KJV: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
text.ASV: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
text.WEB: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

text.KJV: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
text.ASV: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.
text.WEB: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

text.KJV: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
text.ASV: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore. Psalm 122 A Song of Ascents; of David.
text.WEB: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

text.KJV: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
text.ASV: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.
text.WEB: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”

text.KJV: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
text.ASV: Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,
text.WEB: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem;

text.KJV: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
text.ASV: Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;
text.WEB: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together;

text.KJV: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, `For' an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.
text.WEB: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.

text.KJV: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
text.ASV: For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.
text.WEB: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

text.KJV: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
text.ASV: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.
text.WEB: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

text.KJV: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
text.ASV: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.
text.WEB: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

text.KJV: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
text.ASV: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
text.WEB: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

text.KJV: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
text.ASV: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good. Psalm 123 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.

text.KJV: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
text.ASV: Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.
text.WEB: To you I do lift up my eyes, you who sit in the heavens.

text.KJV: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
text.ASV: Behold, as the eyes of servants `look' unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes `look' unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.
text.WEB: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.

text.KJV: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
text.ASV: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
text.WEB: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

text.KJV: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
text.ASV: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud. Psalm 124 A Song of Ascents; of David.
text.WEB: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

text.KJV: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
text.ASV: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,
text.WEB: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,

text.KJV: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
text.ASV: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;
text.WEB: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;

text.KJV: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
text.ASV: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us;
text.WEB: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

text.KJV: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
text.ASV: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;
text.WEB: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;

text.KJV: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
text.ASV: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
text.WEB: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

text.KJV: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
text.ASV: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.
text.WEB: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

text.KJV: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
text.ASV: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth. Psalm 125 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.

text.KJV: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
text.ASV: They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.
text.WEB: Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

text.KJV: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
text.ASV: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.
text.WEB: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so Yahweh surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

text.KJV: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
text.ASV: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
text.WEB: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous; so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

text.KJV: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
text.ASV: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.
text.WEB: Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

text.KJV: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
text.ASV: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel. Psalm 126 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

text.KJV: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
text.ASV: When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
text.WEB: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

text.KJV: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
text.ASV: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.
text.WEB: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”

text.KJV: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath done great things for us, `Whereof' we are glad.
text.WEB: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

text.KJV: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
text.ASV: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.
text.WEB: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.

text.KJV: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
text.ASV: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
text.WEB: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

text.KJV: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
text.ASV: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves `with him'. Psalm 127 A Song of Ascents; of Solomon.
text.WEB: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

text.KJV: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
text.ASV: Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.
text.WEB: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they labor in vain who build it. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

text.KJV: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
text.ASV: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; `For' so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.
text.WEB: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

text.KJV: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
text.ASV: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; `And' the fruit of the womb is `his' reward.
text.WEB: Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

text.KJV: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
text.ASV: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.
text.WEB: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

text.KJV: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
text.ASV: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate. Psalm 128 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

text.KJV: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
text.ASV: Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.
text.WEB: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.

text.KJV: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
text.ASV: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
text.WEB: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

text.KJV: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
text.ASV: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.
text.WEB: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of your house; your children like olive plants, around your table.

text.KJV: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
text.ASV: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.
text.WEB: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.

text.KJV: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
text.ASV: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
text.WEB: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

text.KJV: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
text.ASV: Yea, see thou thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel. Psalm 129 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

text.KJV: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
text.ASV: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,
text.WEB: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,

text.KJV: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
text.ASV: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.
text.WEB: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

text.KJV: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
text.ASV: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.
text.WEB: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

text.KJV: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
text.ASV: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
text.WEB: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

text.KJV: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
text.ASV: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.
text.WEB: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

text.KJV: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
text.ASV: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;
text.WEB: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up;

text.KJV: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
text.ASV: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
text.WEB: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

text.KJV: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
text.ASV: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah. Psalm 130 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”

text.KJV: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
text.ASV: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

text.KJV: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
text.ASV: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.
text.WEB: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

text.KJV: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
text.ASV: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
text.WEB: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

text.KJV: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
text.ASV: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.
text.WEB: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

text.KJV: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
text.ASV: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.
text.WEB: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

text.KJV: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
text.ASV: My soul `waiteth' for the Lord More than watchmen `wait' for the morning; `Yea, more than' watchmen for the morning.
text.WEB: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning; more than watchmen for the morning.

text.KJV: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
text.ASV: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.
text.WEB: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for with Yahweh there is loving kindness. With him is abundant redemption.

text.KJV: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
text.ASV: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities. Psalm 131 A Song of Ascents; of David.
text.WEB: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

text.KJV: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
text.ASV: Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, Or in things too wonderful for me.
text.WEB: Yahweh, my heart isn’t haughty, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

text.KJV: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
text.ASV: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother, Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
text.WEB: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

text.KJV: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
text.ASV: O Israel, hope in Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Psalm 132 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.

text.KJV: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:
text.ASV: Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;
text.WEB: Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,

text.KJV: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
text.ASV: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:
text.WEB: how he swore to Yahweh, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

text.KJV: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
text.ASV: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;
text.WEB: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

text.KJV: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
text.ASV: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;
text.WEB: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;

text.KJV: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
text.ASV: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.
text.WEB: until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

text.KJV: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
text.ASV: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.
text.WEB: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar:

text.KJV: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
text.ASV: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.
text.WEB: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.

text.KJV: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
text.ASV: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.
text.WEB: Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place; you, and the ark of your strength.

text.KJV: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
text.ASV: Let thy priest be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.
text.WEB: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!”

text.KJV: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
text.ASV: For thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.
text.WEB: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

text.KJV: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
text.ASV: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
text.WEB: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

text.KJV: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
text.ASV: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.
text.WEB: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

text.KJV: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
text.ASV: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.
text.WEB: For Yahweh has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

text.KJV: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
text.ASV: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
text.WEB: “This is my resting place forever. Here I will live, for I have desired it.

text.KJV: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
text.ASV: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
text.WEB: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

text.KJV: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
text.ASV: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
text.WEB: Her priests I will also clothe with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

text.KJV: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
text.ASV: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
text.WEB: There I will make the horn of David to bud. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

text.KJV: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
text.ASV: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish. Psalm 133 A Song of Ascents; of David.
text.WEB: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will be resplendent.”

text.KJV: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
text.ASV: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
text.WEB: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

text.KJV: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
text.ASV: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron's beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;
text.WEB: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard; that came down on the edge of his robes;

text.KJV: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
text.ASV: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore. Psalm 134 A Song of Ascents.
text.WEB: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion: for there Yahweh gives the blessing, even life forever more.

text.KJV: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
text.ASV: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

text.KJV: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
text.ASV: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!

text.KJV: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
text.ASV: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.
text.WEB: May Yahweh bless you from Zion; even he who made heaven and earth.

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise `him', O ye servants of Jehovah,
text.WEB: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,

text.KJV: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
text.ASV: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.
text.WEB: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

text.KJV: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
text.WEB: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

text.KJV: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
text.ASV: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, `And' Israel for his own possession.
text.WEB: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself; Israel for his own possession.

text.KJV: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
text.ASV: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.
text.WEB: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

text.KJV: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
text.ASV: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;
text.WEB: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

text.KJV: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
text.ASV: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;
text.WEB: who causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth; who makes lightnings with the rain; who brings the wind out of his treasuries;

text.KJV: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
text.ASV: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;
text.WEB: Who struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal;

text.KJV: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
text.ASV: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;
text.WEB: Who sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants;

text.KJV: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
text.ASV: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,
text.WEB: who struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,

text.KJV: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
text.ASV: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,
text.WEB: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,

text.KJV: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
text.ASV: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.
text.WEB: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

text.KJV: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
text.ASV: Thy name, O Jehovah, `endureth' for ever; Thy memorial `name', O Jehovah, throughout all generations.
text.WEB: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.

text.KJV: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
text.ASV: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.
text.WEB: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants.

text.KJV: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
text.ASV: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.
text.WEB: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

text.KJV: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
text.ASV: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;
text.WEB: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

text.KJV: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
text.ASV: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.
text.WEB: They have ears, but they can’t hear; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

text.KJV: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
text.ASV: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.
text.WEB: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

text.KJV: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
text.ASV: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:
text.WEB: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!

text.KJV: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
text.ASV: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, Who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto the God of gods; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Give thanks to the God of gods; for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto the Lord of lords; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: To him who alone doeth great wonders; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: To him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: To him that by understanding made the heavens; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: To him who by understanding made the heavens; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: To him that spread forth the earth above the waters; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: To him who spread out the earth above the waters; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: To him that made great lights; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: To him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: The sun to rule by day; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: The sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: The moon and stars to rule by night; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: The moon and stars to rule by night; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: To him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: And brought out Israel from among them; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: And brought out Israel from among them; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: To him that divided the Red Sea in sunder; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: To him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: And made Israel to pass through the middle of it; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: To him that led his people through the wilderness; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: To him who led his people through the wilderness; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: To him that smote great kings; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: To him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: And slew famous kings; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: And killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: Sihon king of the Amorites; For his lovingkindness `endureth' forever;
text.WEB: Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: And Og king of Bashan; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: Og king of Bashan; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: And gave their land for a heritage; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: And gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Even a heritage unto Israel his servant; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: Even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
text.ASV: Who remembered us in our low estate; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever;
text.WEB: Who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;

text.KJV: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: And hath delivered us from our adversaries; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever:
text.WEB: And has delivered us from our adversaries; for his loving kindness endures forever:

text.KJV: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Who giveth food to all flesh; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
text.ASV: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness `endureth' for ever.
text.WEB: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven; for his loving kindness endures forever.

text.KJV: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
text.ASV: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
text.WEB: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

text.KJV: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
text.ASV: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
text.WEB: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

text.KJV: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
text.ASV: For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us `required of us' mirth, `saying', Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
text.WEB: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

text.KJV: How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?
text.ASV: How shall we sing Jehovah's song In a foreign land?
text.WEB: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?

text.KJV: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
text.ASV: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget `her skill'.
text.WEB: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

text.KJV: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
text.ASV: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.
text.WEB: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you; if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

text.KJV: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
text.ASV: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.
text.WEB: Remember, Yahweh, against the children of Edom, the day of Jerusalem; who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

text.KJV: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
text.ASV: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.
text.WEB: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who rewards you, as you have served us.

text.KJV: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
text.ASV: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock. Psalm 138 A `Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

text.KJV: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
text.ASV: I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.
text.WEB: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

text.KJV: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
text.ASV: I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
text.WEB: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

text.KJV: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
text.ASV: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
text.WEB: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

text.KJV: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
text.ASV: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.
text.WEB: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

text.KJV: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
text.ASV: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh; for great is Yahweh’s glory.

text.KJV: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
text.ASV: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.
text.WEB: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but the proud, he knows from afar.

text.KJV: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
text.ASV: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.
text.WEB: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

text.KJV: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
text.ASV: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, `endureth' for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands. Psalm 139 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

text.KJV: O lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.
text.ASV: O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known `me'.
text.WEB: Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.

text.KJV: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
text.ASV: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.
text.WEB: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

text.KJV: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
text.ASV: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.
text.WEB: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

text.KJV: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
text.ASV: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.
text.WEB: For there is not a word on my tongue, but, behold, Yahweh, you know it altogether.

text.KJV: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
text.ASV: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.
text.WEB: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

text.KJV: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
text.ASV: `Such' knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.
text.WEB: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

text.KJV: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
text.ASV: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
text.WEB: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

text.KJV: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
text.ASV: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.
text.WEB: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

text.KJV: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
text.ASV: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
text.WEB: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea;

text.KJV: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
text.ASV: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.
text.WEB: Even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

text.KJV: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
text.ASV: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;
text.WEB: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me; the light around me will be night”;

text.KJV: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
text.ASV: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike `to thee'.
text.WEB: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

text.KJV: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
text.ASV: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother's womb.
text.WEB: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

text.KJV: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
text.ASV: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.
text.WEB: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

text.KJV: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
text.ASV: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, `And' curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
text.WEB: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

text.KJV: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
text.ASV: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, `Even' the days that were ordained `for me', When as yet there was none of them.
text.WEB: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

text.KJV: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
text.ASV: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
text.WEB: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

text.KJV: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
text.ASV: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.
text.WEB: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

text.KJV: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
text.ASV: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.
text.WEB: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

text.KJV: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
text.ASV: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take `thy name' in vain.
text.WEB: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

text.KJV: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
text.ASV: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
text.WEB: Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

text.KJV: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
text.ASV: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.
text.WEB: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

text.KJV: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
text.ASV: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;
text.WEB: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

text.KJV: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
text.ASV: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting. Psalm 140 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

text.KJV: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
text.ASV: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:
text.WEB: Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man;

text.KJV: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
text.ASV: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.
text.WEB: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

text.KJV: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
text.ASV: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders' poison is under their lips. Selah
text.WEB: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

text.KJV: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
text.ASV: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.
text.WEB: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

text.KJV: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
text.ASV: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. Selah
text.WEB: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

text.KJV: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
text.ASV: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.
text.WEB: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

text.KJV: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
text.ASV: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
text.WEB: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

text.KJV: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
text.ASV: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, `lest' they exalt themselves. Selah
text.WEB: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

text.KJV: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
text.ASV: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
text.WEB: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

text.KJV: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
text.ASV: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.
text.WEB: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

text.KJV: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
text.ASV: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
text.WEB: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

text.KJV: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
text.ASV: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.
text.WEB: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

text.KJV: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
text.ASV: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence. Psalm 141 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

text.KJV: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
text.ASV: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.
text.WEB: Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

text.KJV: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
text.ASV: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
text.WEB: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

text.KJV: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
text.ASV: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.
text.WEB: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

text.KJV: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
text.ASV: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.
text.WEB: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

text.KJV: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
text.ASV: Let the righteous smite me, `it shall be' a kindness; And let him reprove me, `it shall be as' oil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.
text.WEB: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

text.KJV: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
text.ASV: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
text.WEB: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

text.KJV: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
text.ASV: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
text.WEB: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

text.KJV: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
text.ASV: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.
text.WEB: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

text.KJV: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
text.ASV: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.
text.WEB: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

text.KJV: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
text.ASV: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape. Psalm 142 Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer.
text.WEB: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, while I pass by.

text.KJV: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
text.ASV: I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.
text.WEB: I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.

text.KJV: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
text.ASV: I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.
text.WEB: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

text.KJV: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
text.ASV: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.
text.WEB: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

text.KJV: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
text.ASV: Look on `my' right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.
text.WEB: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

text.KJV: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
text.ASV: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.
text.WEB: I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

text.KJV: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
text.ASV: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.
text.WEB: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. deliver me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than me.

text.KJV: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
text.ASV: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me. Psalm 143 A Psalm of David.
text.WEB: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

text.KJV: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
text.ASV: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, `and' in thy righteousness.
text.WEB: Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

text.KJV: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
text.ASV: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.
text.WEB: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

text.KJV: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
text.ASV: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
text.WEB: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

text.KJV: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
text.ASV: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.
text.WEB: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

text.KJV: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
text.ASV: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.
text.WEB: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

text.KJV: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
text.ASV: I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul `thirsteth' after thee, as a weary land. Selah
text.WEB: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

text.KJV: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
text.ASV: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.
text.WEB: Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

text.KJV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
text.ASV: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.
text.WEB: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
