text.KJV: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
text.ASV: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
text.WEB: Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

text.KJV: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
text.ASV: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.
text.WEB: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

text.KJV: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
text.ASV: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
text.WEB: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

text.KJV: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
text.ASV: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant. Psalm 144 `A Psalm' of David.
text.WEB: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, For I am your servant.

text.KJV: Blessed be the LORD my strength which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
text.ASV: Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, `And' my fingers to fight:
text.WEB: Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to battle:

text.KJV: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
text.ASV: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
text.WEB: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge; who subdues my people under me.

text.KJV: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
text.ASV: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?
text.WEB: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

text.KJV: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
text.ASV: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.
text.WEB: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

text.KJV: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
text.ASV: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
text.WEB: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

text.KJV: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
text.ASV: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.
text.WEB: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

text.KJV: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
text.ASV: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;
text.WEB: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners;

text.KJV: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
text.ASV: Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
text.WEB: whose mouths speak deceit, Whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

text.KJV: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
text.ASV: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
text.WEB: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

text.KJV: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
text.ASV: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings; Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
text.WEB: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

text.KJV: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
text.ASV: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
text.WEB: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

text.KJV: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
text.ASV: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;
text.WEB: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

text.KJV: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
text.ASV: `When' our garners are full, affording all manner of store, `And' our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;
text.WEB: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

text.KJV: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
text.ASV: `When' our oxen are well laden; `When there is' no breaking in, and no going forth, And no outcry in our streets:
text.WEB: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

text.KJV: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
text.ASV: Happy is the people that is in such a case; `Yea', happy is the people whose God is Jehovah. Psalm 145 `A' `Psalm' `of' praise; of David.
text.WEB: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.

text.KJV: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
text.ASV: I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
text.WEB: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

text.KJV: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
text.ASV: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
text.WEB: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

text.KJV: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
text.ASV: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.
text.WEB: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

text.KJV: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
text.ASV: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.
text.WEB: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

text.KJV: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
text.ASV: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.
text.WEB: Of the glorious majesty of your honor, of your wondrous works, I will meditate.

text.KJV: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
text.ASV: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.
text.WEB: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

text.KJV: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
text.ASV: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.
text.WEB: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

text.KJV: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
text.ASV: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.
text.WEB: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

text.KJV: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
text.ASV: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.
text.WEB: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

text.KJV: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
text.ASV: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.
text.WEB: All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

text.KJV: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
text.ASV: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;
text.WEB: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power;

text.KJV: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
text.ASV: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
text.WEB: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

text.KJV: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
text.ASV: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion `endureth' throughout all generations.
text.WEB: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. Yahweh is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

text.KJV: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
text.ASV: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.
text.WEB: Yahweh upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

text.KJV: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
text.ASV: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.
text.WEB: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

text.KJV: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
text.ASV: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
text.WEB: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

text.KJV: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
text.ASV: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.
text.WEB: Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

text.KJV: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
text.ASV: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.
text.WEB: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

text.KJV: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
text.ASV: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.
text.WEB: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

text.KJV: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
text.ASV: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.
text.WEB: Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

text.KJV: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
text.ASV: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
text.WEB: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
text.WEB: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.

text.KJV: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
text.ASV: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
text.WEB: While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

text.KJV: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
text.ASV: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
text.WEB: Don’t put your trust in princes, each a son of man in whom there is no help.

text.KJV: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
text.ASV: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.
text.WEB: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

text.KJV: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
text.ASV: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:
text.WEB: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:

text.KJV: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
text.ASV: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;
text.WEB: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

text.KJV: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
text.ASV: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;
text.WEB: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. Yahweh frees the prisoners.

text.KJV: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
text.ASV: Jehovah openeth `the eyes of' the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;
text.WEB: Yahweh opens the eyes of the blind. Yahweh raises up those who are bowed down. Yahweh loves the righteous.

text.KJV: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
text.ASV: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
text.WEB: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but the way of the wicked he turns upside down.

text.KJV: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, `and' praise is comely.
text.WEB: Praise Yah, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

text.KJV: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
text.ASV: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
text.WEB: Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

text.KJV: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
text.ASV: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
text.WEB: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

text.KJV: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
text.ASV: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by `their' names.
text.WEB: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

text.KJV: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
text.ASV: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.
text.WEB: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

text.KJV: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
text.ASV: Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.
text.WEB: Yahweh upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

text.KJV: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
text.ASV: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,
text.WEB: Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

text.KJV: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
text.ASV: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
text.WEB: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

text.KJV: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
text.ASV: He giveth to the beast his food, `And' to the young ravens which cry.
text.WEB: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

text.KJV: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
text.ASV: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.
text.WEB: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

text.KJV: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
text.ASV: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his lovingkindness.
text.WEB: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

text.KJV: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
text.ASV: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

text.KJV: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
text.ASV: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.
text.WEB: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

text.KJV: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
text.ASV: He maketh peace in thy borders; He filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
text.WEB: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

text.KJV: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
text.ASV: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.
text.WEB: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

text.KJV: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
text.ASV: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.
text.WEB: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

text.KJV: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
text.ASV: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?
text.WEB: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

text.KJV: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
text.ASV: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
text.WEB: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

text.KJV: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
text.ASV: He showeth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his ordinances unto Israel.
text.WEB: He shows his word to Jacob; his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

text.KJV: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for his ordinances, they have not known them. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.
text.WEB: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

text.KJV: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
text.ASV: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.
text.WEB: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

text.KJV: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
text.ASV: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.
text.WEB: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

text.KJV: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
text.ASV: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.
text.WEB: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, You waters that are above the heavens.

text.KJV: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
text.ASV: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.
text.WEB: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, For he commanded, and they were created.

text.KJV: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
text.ASV: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.
text.WEB: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

text.KJV: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
text.ASV: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths;

text.KJV: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
text.ASV: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
text.WEB: lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

text.KJV: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
text.ASV: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;
text.WEB: mountains and all hills; fruit trees and all cedars;

text.KJV: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
text.ASV: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;
text.WEB: wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and flying birds;

text.KJV: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
text.ASV: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;
text.WEB: kings of the earth and all peoples; princes and all judges of the earth;

text.KJV: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
text.ASV: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:
text.WEB: both young men and maidens; old men and children:

text.KJV: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
text.ASV: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
text.WEB: let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

text.KJV: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.
text.WEB: Praise Yahweh! Sing to Yahweh a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

text.KJV: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
text.ASV: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
text.WEB: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

text.KJV: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
text.ASV: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.
text.WEB: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

text.KJV: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
text.ASV: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.
text.WEB: For Yahweh takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

text.KJV: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
text.ASV: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.
text.WEB: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

text.KJV: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
text.ASV: `Let' the high praises of God `be' in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;
text.WEB: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand;

text.KJV: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
text.ASV: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;
text.WEB: To execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

text.KJV: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
text.ASV: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;
text.WEB: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

text.KJV: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise Yah!

text.KJV: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
text.ASV: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
text.WEB: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

text.KJV: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
text.ASV: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.
text.WEB: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

text.KJV: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
text.ASV: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.
text.WEB: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

text.KJV: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
text.ASV: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.
text.WEB: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

text.KJV: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
text.ASV: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.
text.WEB: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

text.KJV: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
text.ASV: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
text.WEB: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
